To enable correctability, we introduce Token-level Reward for Utility-Steered Chain-of-Thought (TRUST), an offline-trained value model that predicts eventual reasoning correctness from partial prefixes and uses these estimates to monitor and selectively steer reasoning generation in frozen VLA policies. On the Alpamayo 1.5 driving VLA, TRUST monitors correctness with 88.9% accuracy and improves reasoning correctness from 75.9% to 90.0%. On a baseline-defined challenging subset in AlpaSim, TRUST reduces collision rate by 30.4% and maximum trajectory error by 11.5% relative to the unsteered policy, outperforming a compute-matched Best-of-4 baseline. On the DeepThinkVLA manipulation VLA, TRUST improves the correctness of grasp-state claims from 69.3% to 90.2% and action-choice claims from 68.8% to 85.9%, yet closed-loop task performance on LIBERO-Plus remains largely unchanged. Empirical analysis reveals intent-consistent behavioral effects in Alpamayo 1.5 but limited effects in DeepThinkVLA, helping interpret these different task-level outcomes. Together, our results show that gains in reasoning correctness do not automatically imply gains in embodied performance, motivating evaluation of correctability and actionability when using CoT as a runtime safety interface.
summary_zh: 具备推理能力的视觉-语言-行动（VLA）策略会暴露其思维链（CoT）轨迹，这些轨迹看似解释并引导了其行为，从而为通过推理监控与修正实现运行时安全提供了潜在接口。在本工作中，我们定义并操作化两个评估维度，用以衡量该接口何时能够改善具身行为：可修正性（correctability），即检测不可靠推理并在生成过程中加以改进的能力；以及可行动性（actionability），即推理修正能否在预期方向上产生具有行为意义的改变。为实现可修正性，我们引入了面向效用导向思维链的令牌级奖励（Token-level Reward for Utility-Steered Chain-of-Thought，简称TRUST），这是一种离线训练的价值模型，能够从部分前缀预测最终推理正确性，并利用这些估计对冻结的VLA策略中的推理生成进行监控和选择性引导。在Alpamayo 1.5驾驶VLA上，TRUST以88.9%的准确率监控推理正确性，并将推理正确性从75.9%提升至90.0%。在AlpaSim中基于基线定义的挑战性子集上，TRUST相较于未引导策略将碰撞率降低了30.4%，最大轨迹误差降低了11.5%，优于计算资源匹配的Best-of-4基线。在DeepThinkVLA操作VLA上，TRUST将抓取状态断言的正确性从69.3%提升至90.2%，动作选择断言的正确性从68.8%提升至85.9%，然而在LIBERO-Plus上的闭环任务性能基本保持不变。实证分析揭示了Alpamayo 1.5中意图一致的行为效应，而DeepThinkVLA中的效应有限，这有助于解释不同的任务级结果。综合来看，我们的结果表明，推理正确性的提升并不自动意味着具身性能的提升，这促使在将思维链作为运行时安全接口时，有必要对可修正性和可行动性进行评估。
tldr: This paper introduces TRUST, an offline-trained value model that monitors and steers chain-of-thought reasoning in frozen VLA policies, improving reasoning correctness and reducing collision rate in driving while showing limited closed-loop gains in manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了TRUST，一种离线训练的价值模型，用于监控和引导冻结的VLA策略中的思维链推理，在驾驶任务中提高了推理正确性并降低了碰撞率，但在操作任务中的闭环性能提升有限。

title: Token-World: World Modeling in Vision-Language Model Token Space for Robot Manipulation
summary: A common approach to world-model simulation for vision-language-action (VLA) systems is to predict future RGB observations and then re-encode them into policy inputs, introducing an indirect interface between simulation and downstream policy execution. We instead investigate whether world dynamics can be modeled in a compact, policy-oriented state derived from VLM visual tokens. A key challenge is that raw VLM visual tokens are high-dimensional, making efficient and accurate autoregressive dynamics modeling challenging. To address this, we introduce Token-World, an action-conditioned world model that compresses VLM features into a compact token state, learns future dynamics in this reduced space, and maps predicted states back to the original policy-facing representation for downstream use. Across manipulation benchmarks, Token-World improves open-loop feature fidelity and policy-action consistency over recent world-model simulators, with slower degradation over long rollout horizons. In closed-loop evaluation, its simulated policy performance correlates more strongly with reference policy performance than Ctrl-World ($r=0.794$ vs.\ $0.583$), while requiring lower simulation latency. Ablations further show that compact-representation design and dimensionality substantially affect future-state prediction. Code will be available at https://chuyaofu.github.io/Token-World/.
summary_zh: 针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）系统的世界模型仿真，一种常见方法是预测未来的RGB观测，然后将其重新编码为策略输入，从而在仿真与下游策略执行之间引入间接接口。相反，我们研究是否可以在由VLM视觉标记导出的紧凑、面向策略的状态中建模世界动态。一个关键挑战在于，原始的VLM视觉标记维度较高，使得高效且准确的自回归动态建模颇具难度。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Token-World，一种动作条件世界模型，它将VLM特征压缩为紧凑的标记状态，在此降维空间中学习未来动态，并将预测状态映射回原始的策略面向表示以供下游使用。在多个操作基准测试中，Token-World在开环特征保真度和策略动作一致性方面优于近期世界模型仿真器，且在长程推演中退化更慢。在闭环评估中，其仿真策略性能与参考策略性能的相关性显著强于Ctrl-World（$r=0.794$ 对比 $0.583$），同时仿真延迟更低。消融实验进一步表明，紧凑表示设计和维度对未来状态预测有显著影响。代码将发布于 https://chuyaofu.github.io/Token-World/。
tldr: Token-World introduces an action-conditioned world model that compresses VLM visual tokens into a compact state, learns future dynamics in this reduced space, and maps predictions back for robot manipulation, improving simulation fidelity and closed-loop correlation with policy performance.
tldr_zh: Token-World 提出了一种动作条件世界模型，将 VLM 视觉标记压缩为紧凑状态，在该缩减空间中学习未来动态，并将预测映射回策略表示，用于机器人操作，提高了仿真保真度和闭环策略性能相关性。

title: Fewer Tokens, Better Action: GPT-6 Astra Robot Agents with 14% Higher Success Rate but 65% Fewer Tokens
summary: Vision language model (VLM) agents can control robots through visual feedback and action primitives, but repeated model invocations and redundant observations incur substantial token overhead. We introduce PyRUA-Lean, an interactive code-execution framework that couples feedback-driven primitive composition with selective observation: the agent composes classical robot primitives and learned vision-language-action (VLA) policies into Python cells that perform conditional checks and local retries, returning only explicitly requested images and state feedback for replanning. Across 700 simulated task instances from LIBERO-PRO, RoboTwin 2.0, and RoboCasa365, we compare PyRUA-Lean with a tool-calling baseline using the same GPT-6 Astra planner and underlying robot primitives. Under equal LLM-call budgets, PyRUA-Lean increases overall success from 63.1% to 71.7%. On instances solved by both agents, it uses 49% fewer LLM calls and 65% fewer input tokens.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体能够通过视觉反馈和动作原语控制机器人，但反复的模型调用和冗余的观测会造成大量的令牌开销。我们提出了PyRUA-Lean，一种交互式代码执行框架，将反馈驱动的原语组合与选择性观测相结合：智能体将经典机器人原语和习得的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略组合成Python单元，这些单元可执行条件检查和局部重试，仅返回显式请求的图像和状态反馈以用于重新规划。在来自LIBERO-PRO、RoboTwin 2.0和RoboCasa365的700个模拟任务实例中，我们使用相同的GPT-6 Astra规划器和底层机器人原语，将PyRUA-Lean与一个工具调用基线进行了比较。在相同的LLM调用预算下，PyRUA-Lean将整体成功率从63.1%提升至71.7%。在两个智能体均解决的任务实例上，它使用的LLM调用次数减少了49%，输入令牌数量减少了65%。
tldr: This paper introduces PyRUA-Lean, a code-execution framework for VLM-driven robot agents that reduces token overhead by coupling feedback-driven primitive composition with selective observation, achieving higher success rates with fewer tokens across simulated benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了PyRUA-Lean，一种用于VLM驱动的机器人代理的代码执行框架，通过结合反馈驱动的原语组合和选择性观察来减少令牌开销，在多个模拟基准上以更少的令牌实现了更高的成功率。

title: MapLightning: Online Vectorized HD Map Construction with 1D Map Tokens
summary: Online vectorized HD map construction is essential for scaling safe autonomous driving and requires accurate, real-time inference. Prior methods typically rely on dense bird's-eye-view (BEV) grids as the intermediate representation. We propose \textit{MapLightning}, which replaces the dense BEV grid with a compact set of 1D learnable map tokens. To construct map tokens from image features, we choose self-attention over vanilla cross-attention because it enables joint interactions and contextual aggregation among image and map tokens. Our transformer-based mapper concatenates map and image tokens, applies full self-attention, discards the image tokens, and retains the updated map tokens for decoding. This design offers three advantages. First, our representation is efficient, using fewer tokens, consuming less memory, and running faster. Second, the lightweight design allows the map decoder to use full rather than deformable cross-attention for better global context. Third, unlike BEV-based methods, our network does not use camera projection parameters, making it robust to camera-extrinsic perturbations. MapLightning uses up to 16.7$\times$ fewer intermediate tokens than dense BEV-based methods and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and efficiency on nuScenes and Argoverse~2. Its lightweight variant surpasses MapTRv2 by +10.1 mAP on nuScenes and +16.2 mAP on Argoverse~2, while delivering 1.73$\times$ faster inference (40+ FPS) with 53\% less memory. We further show improvements on uncertainty-aware map construction and downstream trajectory prediction. Code and models will be released.
summary_zh: 在线矢量化高清地图构建对于扩展安全的自动驾驶至关重要，需要准确且实时的推理。现有方法通常依赖密集的鸟瞰图（BEV）网格作为中间表示。我们提出\textit{MapLightning}，用一组紧凑的一维可学习地图令牌替代密集的BEV网格。为了从图像特征构建地图令牌，我们选择自注意力而非普通交叉注意力，因为它能够实现图像令牌与地图令牌之间的联合交互和上下文聚合。我们基于Transformer的地图构建器将地图令牌和图像令牌拼接，应用完整的自注意力，丢弃图像令牌，并保留更新后的地图令牌用于解码。该设计具有三个优势。第一，我们的表示高效，使用更少的令牌，消耗更少的内存，运行速度更快。第二，轻量级设计使地图解码器能够使用完整的而非可变形交叉注意力，以获得更好的全局上下文。第三，与基于BEV的方法不同，我们的网络不使用相机投影参数，因此对相机外参扰动具有鲁棒性。MapLightning使用的中间令牌数量比基于密集BEV的方法最多减少16.7$\times$，并在nuScenes和Argoverse~2上实现了最先进的准确性和效率。其轻量级变体在nuScenes上比MapTRv2高出+10.1 mAP，在Argoverse~2上高出+16.2 mAP，同时推理速度提高了1.73$\times$（40+ FPS），内存占用减少53\%。我们进一步展示了在不确定性感知地图构建和下游轨迹预测方面的改进。代码和模型将公开发布。
tldr: MapLightning constructs vectorized HD maps online using compact 1D learnable map tokens and full self-attention, replacing dense BEV grids to achieve state-of-the-art accuracy, faster inference, and lower memory on nuScenes and Argoverse 2, while also improving uncertainty estimation and downstream trajectory prediction.
tldr_zh: MapLightning 使用紧凑的 1D 可学习地图标记和全自注意力在线构建矢量化高清地图，替代密集 BEV 网格，在 nuScenes 和 Argoverse 2 上实现了最先进的精度、更快的推理速度和更低的内存占用，同时改进了不确定性估计和下游轨迹预测。

title: Oneira: From Open-Ended Generation to Open-World Interaction in Video World Models
summary: Generative video world models can now synthesize open-ended environments that agents can navigate and interact with in simple ways. Yet open-ended generation does not imply full interaction: as a generated world expands, newly created content through navigation should expand what the agent can act upon, and as the agent changes the world, those changes should become persistent parts of the environment rather than transient visual effects. We characterize these two requirements as Open-World Interactivity, where newly generated or encountered entities are incorporated into the actionable world, and Persistent State, where interaction outcomes are committed to the world state and continue to influence subsequent observations and interactions. We present Oneira, an interactive video world model that closes the loop between generation and interaction through an explicit, extensible world state managed by a coding agent. Given the current observation and an action or high-level goal, the agent reads the world state, grounds the relevant entities, plans the interaction, and writes its outcome back into a world state table. When exploration reveals new objects, the agent incorporates them from generated observations, allowing the interaction space to expand with the generated world. Meanwhile, previously induced state changes are carried across video segments, making the consequences of interaction persistent parts of subsequent world evolution. The updated world state is rendered along the camera action trajectory into a coarse conditioning video, from which a video generator fills in the appearance, motion, and interaction details not represented in the state. Experiments show that Oneira enables direct and consistent interaction with newly generated objects, while preserving the effects of prior interactions over long horizons. Project page: https://madaoer.github.io/projects/oneira
summary_zh: 生成式视频世界模型现在能够合成开放式的环境，智能体可以在其中以简单方式进行导航和交互。然而，开放式生成并不等同于完全交互：随着生成世界的扩展，通过导航新创建的内容应当扩展智能体可操作的范围；而当智能体改变世界时，这些改变应当成为环境的持久组成部分，而非短暂的视觉效果。我们将这两个要求分别定义为“开放世界交互性”（Open-World Interactivity），即新生成或遇到的实体被纳入可操作的世界中；以及“持久状态”（Persistent State），即交互结果被提交至世界状态，并持续影响后续的观察和交互。我们提出Oneira，一种交互式视频世界模型，通过由编码智能体管理的显式、可扩展的世界状态，实现生成与交互之间的闭环。给定当前观察和一个动作或高层目标，智能体读取世界状态，定位相关实体，规划交互，并将其结果写回世界状态表。当探索揭示新对象时，智能体从生成的观察中将其纳入，从而使交互空间随生成世界一同扩展。同时，先前引发的状态变化会跨视频片段传递，使交互后果成为后续世界演化的持久组成部分。更新后的世界状态沿相机动作轨迹被渲染为粗略的条件视频，视频生成器再据此填充状态中未表示的外观、运动和交互细节。实验表明，Oneira能够实现对新生成对象的直接且一致的交互，同时在长时间跨度内保持先前交互的效果。项目页面：https://madaoer.github.io/projects/oneira
tldr: Oneira introduces an interactive video world model that manages an explicit world state via a coding agent, enabling open-world interaction with newly generated objects and persistent state changes over long horizons.
tldr_zh: Oneira 提出了一种交互式视频世界模型，通过编码代理管理显式世界状态，实现对新增生成对象的直接交互以及长期交互结果的持续保持。

title: CtrlWAM: Controllable World Action Models with Aligned Intent and Foresight
summary: World action models (WAMs) jointly predict actions (intent) and visual future (foresight). Standard training adds noise to recorded actions and video simultaneously, but such training paradigms introduce a mismatch: perturbed actions imply counterfactual future visual, while the noised video remains tied to the GT recording. In low-noise regime, the scene geometry and even the dynamic behavior remain clearly visible from the noisy future frames despite the added noise. We present CtrlWAM, which executes perturbed actions in a simulator and pairs them with their noised visual consequences for joint WAM learning. To accommodate the different denoising requirements of video and actions, we introduce warped video--action noise schedules that aim to keep visual layout responsive as action predictions evolve. We further extend the action interface from ego-only control to a variable number of agent streams, allowing a unified model to represent predicted or commanded futures for multiple agents. Driving experiments show more accurate action forecasts, closer agreement between generated video and actions, and better following of supplied commands; robotics experiments show stronger motion fidelity and controllability. Matched controls support the benefit of off-path renders for command following and manipulation fidelity. Together, these findings contribute to a more controllable world action model. Project page: https://ctrl-wam.github.io/
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）联合预测动作（意图）与视觉未来（预见）。标准训练方式同时对记录的动作和视频添加噪声，但此类训练范式引入了一种不匹配：受扰动的动作意味着反事实的未来视觉，而加噪视频仍与真值记录保持一致。在低噪声条件下，尽管添加了噪声，场景几何结构甚至动态行为仍可从带噪的未来帧中清晰辨识。我们提出CtrlWAM，该方法在模拟器中执行受扰动的动作，并将其与对应的加噪视觉结果配对，以进行联合WAM学习。为适配视频与动作不同的去噪需求，我们引入了扭曲视频-动作噪声调度，旨在随着动作预测的演变保持视觉布局的响应性。我们进一步将动作接口从仅限自我控制扩展至可变数量的智能体流，使统一模型能够表示多个智能体的预测或指令化未来。驾驶实验表明，该方法实现了更精准的动作预测、生成视频与动作之间更高的一致性，以及更优的指令跟随能力；机器人实验则展示了更强的运动保真度与可控性。匹配对照实验支持离路径渲染对指令跟随与操作保真度的增益效果。综上所述，这些发现有助于构建更可控的世界动作模型。项目页面：https://ctrl-wam.github.io/
tldr: CtrlWAM improves world action models by executing perturbed actions in a simulator to create aligned action-video noise pairs, introducing warped noise schedules and multi-agent action interfaces for better controllability in driving and robotics.
tldr_zh: CtrlWAM通过在模拟器中执行扰动动作并配对相应的噪声视觉结果来改进世界动作模型，引入扭曲噪声调度和多智能体动作接口，提升了驾驶和机器人任务中的可控性。

title: Memorizon: Training World Models Beyond Their Context Window
summary: Streaming world models should render a place consistently across repeated visits. Directly supervising such revisits requires training samples that capture both visits, often spanning minutes. Yet dense attention over the full span incurs quadratic costs, making long-span supervision expensive. Memorizon breaks this coupling: long spans are needed for supervision, but not for attention, since the two visits can share a forward pass without including every intervening frame. A training sample covers a span of any length but is scored only on its last $k$ chunks. Instead of tokenizing the history before them, each scored chunk retrieves its own top-$K$ latents by camera co-visibility, and the union of these requests forms a shared bank. The bank is bounded by $kK$, so the sequence stays bounded however long the span; at the shortest span the recipe is exactly conventional training. Adding the bank raises the cost of a step once; beyond that, a longer span costs little, and going from 100 to 400 s adds 12% to the step time. Against a sliding-window baseline, retrieval raises revisit consistency on every split, and a span long enough to reach the first visit of each return adds a further 24% to 30%, at some cost in image quality; beyond that span, more length no longer helps. Filling the bank from another episode lowers revisit correlation by 83%, so the model uses what it retrieves. Project page: https://tingtingliao.github.io/memorizon
summary_zh: 流式世界模型应在重复访问时保持一致的地点渲染。直接监督此类重访需要捕捉两次访问的训练样本，这些访问往往跨越数分钟。然而，对整个时间跨度进行密集注意力计算会产生二次方成本，使得长跨度监督代价高昂。Memorizon打破了这一耦合：长跨度仅用于监督，而非注意力计算，因为两次访问可以共享一次前向传播，而无需包含所有中间帧。一个训练样本可覆盖任意长度的跨度，但仅对其最后k个块进行评分。每个被评分的块并非将之前的全部历史进行分词处理，而是通过相机共视性检索其自身的top-K潜在表示，这些请求的并集构成一个共享记忆库。该记忆库的大小上限为kK，因此无论跨度多长，序列长度始终保持有界；在最短跨度下，该方案与常规训练完全一致。加入记忆库会使单步计算成本增加一次；在此之后，更长的跨度几乎不增加额外开销，从100秒延长至400秒仅使单步时间增加12%。与滑动窗口基线相比，检索在所有分割上都提升了重访一致性，而足以覆盖每次返回首次访问的跨度进一步将一致性提升24%至30%，但以一定的图像质量为代价；超出该跨度后，继续增加长度不再带来收益。从另一情节中填充记忆库会使重访相关性降低83%，这表明模型确实利用了所检索到的内容。项目页面：https://tingtingliao.github.io/memorizon
tldr: Memorizon proposes a training method for streaming world models that decouples supervision span length from attention cost by using a shared bank of top-K retrieved latents, enabling long-span consistency training without quadratic attention.
tldr_zh: Memorizon 提出了一种流式世界模型的训练方法，通过共享的 top-K 检索潜变量库将监督跨度与注意力成本解耦，从而在不增加二次注意力成本的情况下训练长期一致性。

title: Learning Commute-Time-Preserving World Models for Planning
summary: World models allow agents to plan in latent space by choosing a sequence of actions that most reduces the distance to a given goal state. Thus, planning can benefit from latent representations whose distances mirror commute-times in the environment. The spectral embedding space of the graph Laplacian provides such a representation, if it obeys a specific eigenvalue-dependent scaling. Unfortunately, instantiating the graph Laplacian is intractable in large, continuous environments. Self-supervised learning offers a natural route to such commute-time-preserving embeddings at scale. However, here we show that existing methods, which commonly encourage isotropic representations to prevent representational collapse, tend to degrade the "correct" eigenvalue-dependent scaling, leading to an inaccurate representation of commute times. To address this problem, we introduce Commute-Time-Preserving World Models (CTWMs), combining a latent displacement predictor and a log-determinant regularizer that prevents collapse, which provably recover the correctly scaled Laplacian representation under reversible deterministic dynamics and at the predictor's fixed point. In numerical simulations, CTWM matches or outperforms LeWM, a task-agnostic baseline, on several complex, continuous goal-reaching benchmarks, while using half the parameters.
summary_zh: 世界模型使智能体能够在潜空间中通过选择一系列动作进行规划，从而最大程度地缩短与给定目标状态之间的距离。因此，规划可以受益于那些其距离反映环境中游走时间的潜在表征。图拉普拉斯算子的谱嵌入空间提供了这样一种表征，前提是它遵循特定的依赖于特征值的缩放。然而，在大型连续环境中实例化图拉普拉斯算子是难以实现的。自监督学习为在大规模场景下获得这种保持游走时间的嵌入提供了一条自然途径。然而，我们在此表明，现有方法通常鼓励各向同性的表征以防止表征坍缩，却往往破坏“正确的”依赖于特征值的缩放，导致游走时间的表征不准确。为解决这一问题，我们引入了保持游走时间的世界模型（CTWMs），结合了潜在位移预测器和防止坍缩的对数行列式正则化器，在可逆确定性动力学条件下及预测器的固定点处，可证明能够恢复正确缩放的拉普拉斯表征。在数值模拟中，CTWM在多个复杂的连续目标到达基准任务上，与任务无关的基线方法LeWM相比，表现持平或更优，同时仅使用其一半的参数。
tldr: This paper introduces Commute-Time-Preserving World Models (CTWMs), a latent world model that learns commute-time-preserving embeddings for goal-conditioned planning, demonstrating improvements over a task-agnostic baseline on continuous goal-reaching benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了通勤时间保持世界模型（CTWMs），学习保持通勤时间的潜在表示用于目标条件规划，在连续目标到达基准上优于任务无关基线。

title: JEPA-TTT: Persistent Test-Time Training of Latent World Models for Planning under Dynamics Shifts
summary: World models enable agents to plan by predicting future states of the environment, but their predictions can become unreliable when test-time dynamics differ from those seen during training. We present JEPA-TTT, which adapts the latent dynamics predictor of a pretrained action-conditioned Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture world model throughout test time. Self-supervised updates accumulate across episodes, while the visual encoder and reward head remain fixed, preserving the pretrained representation and task objective. Planning requires neither a goal image nor online environment reward. JEPA-TTT uses dense replay, which forms prediction windows at every temporal offset, retains them in a growing buffer, and samples minibatches from that buffer for predictor updates. Across eight dynamics shifts in four continuous-control environments, JEPA-TTT improves planning on every shift. After 500 test-time episodes, it reduces autoregressive latent prediction error by 83% on average and improves planning performance by 153% over the frozen JEPA world model. These results show that persistent self-supervised test-time training can adapt a pretrained latent world model under changed dynamics.
summary_zh: 世界模型使智能体能够通过预测环境的未来状态来进行规划，但当测试时的动态变化与训练期间所见不同时，其预测可能会变得不可靠。我们提出了JEPA-TTT，它在整个测试期间对预训练的动作条件联合嵌入预测架构世界模型的潜在动态预测器进行自适应调整。自监督更新在多个回合中累积，而视觉编码器和奖励头保持固定，从而保留预训练的表示和任务目标。规划既不需要目标图像，也不需要在线环境奖励。JEPA-TTT采用密集回放机制，在每个时间偏移处形成预测窗口，将其保留在不断增长的缓冲区中，并从该缓冲区中采样小批量数据进行预测器更新。在四个连续控制环境中的八种动态变化下，JEPA-TTT在每种变化下均提升了规划性能。经过500个测试回合后，它将自回归潜在预测误差平均降低了83%，并将规划性能相较于冻结的JEPA世界模型提升了153%。这些结果表明，持续的自我监督测试时训练能够在动态变化的情况下自适应预训练的潜在世界模型。
tldr: JEPA-TTT adapts a pretrained latent world model at test time via persistent self-supervised updates, improving planning under dynamics shifts across continuous-control environments.
tldr_zh: JEPA-TTT 通过在测试时进行持续的自我监督更新，使预训练的潜在世界模型适应动态变化，从而在连续控制环境中提升规划性能。

title: Watch, Infer, Coordinate: Inferring Robot Partner Constraints for Zero-Shot Coordination
summary: Robots operating in the physical world will increasingly need to coordinate with other robots, particularly in manipulation tasks where an object may be too large or heavy for a single robot to carry alone. Physical limitations caused by hardware degradation or actuator faults can restrict the actions a robot can reliably execute, yet these limitations may be unknown to its partner. We study whether a helper can infer a robot partner's physical constraints from observing it coordinate with another robot, then use the inferred capability to coordinate with the same partner on a new task. This is difficult because a demonstration shows what the constrained robot did, but not what it could have done. In physically coupled tasks, the other robot may also compensate for its limitations, making those limitations difficult to identify from the constrained robot's behavior alone. Our key insight is that these constraints shape the joint behavior of the team, making the actions of both robots informative about the constrained partner's capability. We introduce Watch, Infer, Coordinate, a benchmark spanning three physically coupled manipulation settings, together with an inference approach that scores candidate constraints using observed joint behavior. Across all three settings, our method substantially improves constraint inference and zero-shot coordination, approaching an oracle with access to the true constraints.
summary_zh: 在物理世界中运行的机器人将日益需要与其他机器人进行协调，尤其是在操作任务中，当物体过大或过重，单个机器人无法独立搬运时。由硬件退化或执行器故障导致的物理限制，可能限制机器人能够可靠执行的动作，然而这些限制对于其合作伙伴而言可能是未知的。我们研究的是，辅助机器人能否通过观察受限机器人与其他机器人的协调过程，推断出其物理限制，并随后利用这一推断出的能力，与同一合作伙伴在新任务上进行协调。这一任务的难点在于，演示只展示了受限机器人实际执行的动作，而未展示其可能执行的动作。在物理耦合任务中，另一机器人也可能对其局限性进行补偿，使得仅从受限机器人自身的行为中识别其限制变得困难。我们的核心见解在于，这些限制塑造了团队的整体行为，从而使两个机器人的动作都包含了关于受限合作伙伴能力的有效信息。我们提出了“观察、推断、协调”（Watch, Infer, Coordinate）框架，这是一个涵盖三种物理耦合操作场景的基准测试，并配套了一种推断方法，利用观测到的联合行为对候选限制进行评分。在所有三种场景中，我们的方法显著提升了限制推断和零样本协调的性能，接近了能够获取真实限制信息的理想基准。
tldr: Introduces a benchmark and inference method for robots to infer a partner's physical constraints from joint behavior, enabling zero-shot coordination in manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个基准和推理方法，使机器人能够通过联合行为推断伙伴的物理约束，从而在操作任务中实现零样本协作。

title: H-SPAR: Hydrodynamic-aware Simulation for Particle Transport and Autonomous Robots
summary: Environmental robotic sampling requires considering the dual influence of water currents on robotic motion and particle transport. Existing marine robotics simulators generally model flow, autonomy, and sampling targets separately, limiting joint evaluation of mission cost and sampling performance. H-SPAR integrates spatially and temporally varying velocity fields, Lagrangian particle transport, probabilistic sampling, and ROS 2/Gazebo-based uncrewed surface vehicle (USV) autonomy. In this work, shared precomputed flow fields drive particle advection and current-induced forces during closed-loop vehicle execution. Path-planning experiments show that the existing current-aware planner SVF-RRT* achieves 69.4% lower upstream cost than conventional RRT* at the planning level, but this reduction falls to 41.7% during execution under time-varying currents, reflecting temporal flow variation, vehicle motion constraints, and path deviation omitted during planning. Coverage experiments show that sweep orientation changes the particle-sampling rate by up to 22.2% under the complete H-SPAR configuration. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating planning, vehicle execution, particle transport, and sampling together under consistent hydrodynamic conditions. The project webpage is available at https://sites.google.com/view/h-spar, and the open-source code is available on GitHub at https://github.com/naviiidz/h-spar-sim.
summary_zh: 环境机器人采样需要考虑水流对机器人运动和颗粒物输运的双重影响。现有海洋机器人仿真系统通常分别对水流、自主性和采样目标进行建模，限制了任务成本与采样性能的联合评估。H-SPAR集成了时空变化的流速场、拉格朗日颗粒输运、概率采样以及基于ROS 2/Gazebo的无人水面艇（USV）自主性。在本研究中，共享的预计算流场在闭环航行器执行过程中同时驱动颗粒物平流和流致作用力。路径规划实验表明，现有的水流感知规划算法SVF-RRT*在规划层面相比传统RRT*将逆流成本降低了69.4%，但在时变水流条件下执行时，该降幅降至41.7%，这反映了规划阶段未考虑的时变水流特征、航行器运动约束以及路径偏差。覆盖实验表明，在完整的H-SPAR配置下，扫描方向的变化会使颗粒物采样率产生最高22.2%的差异。这些发现凸显了在一致的水动力条件下联合评估规划、航行器执行、颗粒物输运和采样性能的重要性。项目网页见https://sites.google.com/view/h-spar，开源代码见GitHub：https://github.com/naviiidz/h-spar-sim。
tldr: H-SPAR is a marine robotics simulator that integrates time-varying flow fields, Lagrangian particle transport, probabilistic sampling, and ROS 2/Gazebo-based USV autonomy to jointly evaluate path planning, vehicle execution, and sampling performance under consistent hydrodynamic conditions.
tldr_zh: H-SPAR 是一个海洋机器人模拟器，集成了时变流场、拉格朗日粒子输运、概率采样和基于 ROS 2/Gazebo 的无人水面艇自主性，以在一致的水动力条件下联合评估路径规划、车辆执行和采样性能。

title: ChunkVLA-AM: Parallel Action Chunking for Vision-Language-Action Robot Control in Additive Manufacturing
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models unify visual perception, language understanding, and action generation, offering new opportunities for automation in additive manufacturing (AM). However, deployment in AM remains challenging because adapting these models to unseen robot embodiments is costly, and performance can degrade under environment changes. In this work, we present a framework for deploying OpenVLA-OFT on a FAIRINO FR3 robot in a fixed AM workcell. A data pipeline converts monocular real-world demonstrations into OpenVLA-compatible TFDS/RLDS datasets to support adaptation to the FR3 embodiment. At runtime, each inference request predicts an eight-step chunk of 7-D actions. The FR3 executes each chunk open loop before capturing a new observation, providing closed-loop feedback between chunks. The system uses a cloud-edge architecture in which the FR3 client streams observations to a remote inference server through a FastAPI interface. In 42 physical A-to-B object-transfer trials, evenly split between red and blue targets, the system succeeded in 39 (92.9%). All three failures occurred during final placement, when insufficient release-height control caused the object to topple. An illumination sweep identified a low-error luminance range of 85-125 on a 0-255 scale, with the lowest mean spatial error at 95.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型统一了视觉感知、语言理解与动作生成，为增材制造（AM）领域的自动化带来了新机遇。然而，由于将这些模型适配至未见过的机器人本体成本高昂，且在环境变化时性能可能下降，其在实际应用中的部署仍面临挑战。本研究提出了一种框架，用于在固定增材制造工作单元中将OpenVLA-OFT部署至FAIRINO FR3机器人。所构建的数据管道将单目真实世界示范数据转换为兼容OpenVLA的TFDS/RLDS数据集，以支持对FR3本体的适配。在运行时，每次推理请求预测一个包含七维动作的八步动作块。FR3在执行完每个动作块后以开环方式运行，随后采集新的观测信息，从而在块间提供闭环反馈。该系统采用云-边架构，其中FR3客户端通过FastAPI接口将观测数据流式传输至远程推理服务器。在42次实际A到B物体搬运试验中（红、蓝目标各半），系统成功39次（成功率92.9%）。全部三次失败均发生在最终放置阶段，原因是释放高度控制不足导致物体倾倒。光照扫描实验确定了在0-255尺度上误差较低的亮度范围为85-125，其中平均空间误差最低点出现在亮度值95处。
tldr: This paper presents a framework for deploying the OpenVLA-OFT vision-language-action model on a FAIRINO FR3 robot in an additive manufacturing workcell, using parallel action chunking and a cloud-edge architecture. Physical trials show a 92.9% success rate in object transfer tasks, with an analysis of illumination effects on performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个框架，将OpenVLA-OFT视觉-语言-动作模型部署在增材制造工作单元中的FAIRINO FR3机器人上，采用并行动作分块和云边架构。物理试验显示物体转移任务成功率为92.9%，并分析了光照对性能的影响。

title: FlashDexRetarget: Accelerating Dexterous Manipulation Data Generation through Multi-Motion Retargeting
summary: Human hand-object demonstrations offer a reusable source of dexterous robot manipulation data, but transferring them across embodiments requires physically feasible retargeting. Existing physics-based approaches face limitations in retargeting success, motion-specific training efficiency, or both. To address these limitations, we introduce FlashDexRetarget, an RL-based framework for high-success, efficient dexterous motion retargeting. To make the demonstrated interaction easier to learn, we combine object point-cloud observations, hand-object distance features, and future trajectory encodings with complementary rewards that supervise object motion and reference hand-object relationships. To further accelerate learning, we employ separate left- and right-hand actor critic networks and adapt the off-policy algorithm, FlashSAC to dexterous motion tracking. On a benchmark of 50 motions spanning single-object and two-object interactions, FlashDexRetarget achieves a 90% success rate, approximately 2.5x that of the evaluated sampling-based baselines, while requiring up to 100x less training compute than the evaluated RL-based baselines. Evaluations on both XHand and Sharpa Wave Hand show consistent gains, and component-wise ablations examine the contributions of our design choices. Beyond the 50-motion benchmark, experiments with 200, 500, and 1,000 motions demonstrate that our method remains stable at larger scales and produces successful retargeted motions more efficiently as the training set grows. Qualitative replay results using real-world-captured demonstrations further illustrate the applicability of our framework to recorded human manipulation. Videos and code are available at https://davian-robotics.github.io/FlashDexRetarget/
summary_zh: 人类手物交互演示为灵巧机器人操作数据提供了可复用的来源，但跨实体迁移这些数据需要物理上可行的重定向。现有基于物理的方法在重定向成功率、特定动作训练效率或两者兼而有之方面存在局限。为解决这些局限，我们提出了FlashDexRetarget，一个基于强化学习的框架，用于实现高成功率、高效率的灵巧运动重定向。为使演示交互更易于学习，我们结合了物体点云观测、手物距离特征和未来轨迹编码，并辅以监督物体运动及参考手物关系的互补奖励。为进一步加速学习，我们采用独立的左手和右手演员-评论家网络，并将离策略算法FlashSAC适配到灵巧运动跟踪中。在涵盖单物体和双物体交互的50个动作基准测试中，FlashDexRetarget实现了90%的成功率，约为所评估的基于采样的基线方法的2.5倍，同时训练计算量比所评估的基于强化学习的基线方法最多减少100倍。在XHand和Sharpa Wave Hand上的评估均显示出一致的性能提升，组件消融实验检验了我们设计选择的贡献。在50个动作基准之外，使用200、500和1000个动作的实验表明，我们的方法在更大规模下保持稳定，且随着训练集的增长，能够更高效地生成成功的重定向动作。使用真实世界采集的演示进行的定性回放结果进一步展示了我们框架在记录的人类操作中的适用性。视频和代码可在https://davian-robotics.github.io/FlashDexRetarget/获取。
tldr: FlashDexRetarget is an RL-based framework for efficient dexterous motion retargeting from human hand-object demonstrations to robotic hands, achieving high success rates with significantly reduced training compute and scaling to large motion datasets.
tldr_zh: FlashDexRetarget 是一个基于强化学习的框架，用于将人手-物体演示高效重定向到机器人手部，在显著降低训练计算量的同时实现高成功率，并可扩展到大规模运动数据集。

title: End-to-End Learning vs. Modular Architectures: Comparative Insights into Autonomous Driving Systems
summary: Autonomous driving systems have become a central focus of intelligent transportation research, with End-to-End Learning and Modular Architectures offering two prominent design paradigms for their implementation. E2E Learning uses deep learning algorithms to map raw sensory inputs directly to driving actuators, providing a streamlined and adaptable solution. while Modular Architectures employ a pipeline-based approach, dividing the system into distinct subsystems for perception, cognition, planning, and control. This paper presents a comprehensive comparative analysis of these paradigms, focusing on their strengths, limitations, and trade-offs to provide insights into their suitability for various autonomous driving applications. The study evaluates key factors such as interpretability, scalability, robustness, and real-world applicability. While End-to-End Learning emphasizes simplicity and adaptability in dynamic environments, it lacks transparency and is highly dependent on large datasets. Conversely, Modular Architectures offer superior interpretability and task-specific optimization, but face challenges related to integration complexity and scalability. To address these limitations, hybrid approaches that combine the strengths of both paradigms have emerged, offering a promising direction for overcoming these challenges. Beyond this comparative synthesis, following work proposes a Four-Dimensional Architecture Selection Framework, comprising twelve binary criteria across safety, operating environment, data/computational resources, and deployment context, and validate it against ten published autonomous driving systems, correctly recommending 7/10 deployed architectures. This work synthesizes existing literature to highlight key trade-offs between the paradigms and identifies hybrid architectures as a promising direction for future research.
summary_zh: 自主驾驶系统已成为智能交通研究的核心焦点，其中端到端学习与模块化架构为其实施提供了两种主流设计范式。端到端学习利用深度学习算法将原始传感器输入直接映射至驾驶执行器，提供了一种精简且适应性强的解决方案；而模块化架构则采用基于流水线的方式，将系统划分为感知、认知、规划与控制等不同子系统。本文对这两种范式进行了全面的比较分析，重点探讨其优势、局限及权衡关系，为它们在不同自主驾驶应用中的适用性提供见解。研究评估了可解释性、可扩展性、鲁棒性及实际应用性等关键因素。尽管端到端学习强调在动态环境中的简洁性与适应性，但其缺乏透明度且高度依赖大规模数据集。相比之下，模块化架构提供了更高的可解释性和任务特定优化能力，但面临集成复杂性与可扩展性方面的挑战。为应对这些局限，融合两种范式优势的混合方法应运而生，为克服上述挑战提供了有前景的方向。在此比较性综述的基础上，后续工作提出了一种四维架构选择框架，包含涵盖安全性、运行环境、数据/计算资源及部署情境的十二项二元标准，并将其应用于十个已发表的自主驾驶系统进行验证，成功推荐了其中7/10的已部署架构。本研究综合现有文献，突出了各范式之间的关键权衡，并指出混合架构是未来研究的一个有前景的方向。
tldr: This paper compares end-to-end learning and modular architectures for autonomous driving, proposing a four-dimensional framework for selecting between them and validating it on ten published systems.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了自动驾驶中的端到端学习与模块化架构，提出了一个四维架构选择框架，并在十个已发表的系统上进行了验证。

title: Query-Conditioned Articulation Estimation from a Single Image
summary: Enabling robots to estimate the kinematic parameters of articulated objects unlocks a wide range of capabilities for interaction and manipulation. The estimation has to happen from the information the robot currently observes, often just a single RGB image of an object it has never seen before. Current single-image approaches couple articulation part segmentation with articulation estimation, making their predictions vulnerable to missed detections and incorrect part associations, and they regress metric 3D geometry that a single view fixes only up to scale. We present QueryArt, a model that estimates articulation parameters from a single RGB image, a 2D query point, and camera intrinsics. QueryArt is trained to estimate the 3D articulation geometry relative to the queried point and in units of its depth, which keeps its target identifiable from the image alone. A single depth measurement at the query point then supplies the scale and recovers the metric parameters. We train QueryArt on a curated mixture of synthetic and real-world articulation datasets. We evaluate QueryArt on several benchmarks and compare it against recent baselines. QueryArt outperforms recent baselines on most articulation metrics, including on out-of-distribution data. To demonstrate the model's capabilities in real-world settings, we evaluate QueryArt on a mobile manipulator across 57 manipulation trials spanning 16 object parts and five viewpoint classes, achieving a 70.2% success rate. We provide code and videos at: https://abwerby.github.io/queryart/
summary_zh: 使机器人能够估计铰接物体的运动学参数，将为其交互与操作解锁广泛的能力。这种估计必须基于机器人当前观测到的信息，而通常仅是一张从未见过物体的单一RGB图像。现有的单图像方法将铰接部分分割与铰接估计耦合在一起，使得其预测容易受到漏检和错误部分关联的影响，同时它们回归的度量3D几何结构在单视图下只能确定到尺度模糊的程度。我们提出了QueryArt，一种能够从单一RGB图像、一个2D查询点和相机内参中估计铰接参数的模型。QueryArt被训练为估计相对于查询点的3D铰接几何结构，并以该点的深度为单位，这使其目标仅凭图像即可被识别。查询点处的单一深度测量随后提供尺度信息并恢复度量参数。我们在精心混合的合成与真实世界铰接数据集上训练QueryArt，并在多个基准上对其进行评估，与近期基线方法进行比较。QueryArt在大多数铰接度量上优于近期基线方法，包括在分布外数据上也是如此。为展示该模型在真实世界场景中的能力，我们在移动机械臂上进行了57次操作试验，涵盖16个物体部件和5个视角类别，成功率达到70.2%。我们提供代码和视频：https://abwerby.github.io/queryart/
tldr: QueryArt estimates articulation parameters of articulated objects from a single RGB image and a 2D query point, using depth-relative geometry to handle scale ambiguity, and demonstrates real-world manipulation on a mobile manipulator.
tldr_zh: QueryArt 从单张RGB图像和2D查询点估计铰接物体的运动学参数，利用深度相对几何解决尺度模糊性，并在移动机械臂上展示了真实世界的操作能力。

title: Learning a Resolution-Consistent Jacobian Field for Bio-Inspired Rigid-Soft Finger
summary: Bio-inspired tendon-driven rigid-soft coupled dexterous fingers exhibit strong nonlinearity and configuration-dependent sensitivity, making accurate modeling challenging. In discrete-time control, Jacobian-based kinematic algorithms typically rely on point-wise local linear approximations, which makes their performance sensitive to sensor sampling frequency and controller update frequency. To address this issue, we propose Jacobian Flow Matching (JFM), a structured learning framework based on Conditional Flow Matching (CFM), to learn a resolution-consistent Jacobian field that models actuation-to-motion transitions as a dynamical flow. The proposed framework supports both single-step prediction and continuous rollout via ODE integration, enabling consistent inference across temporal resolutions. Experiments on a tendon-driven rigid-soft finger show that the proposed method suppresses outlier errors and improves single-step prediction accuracy, reducing the global average RMSE by over 53% compared with a baseline discrete Jacobian learning approach. For long-horizon prediction, trajectories recovered via ODE integration achieve higher fidelity under sparse sampling (Stride = 8), reducing the RMSE median by 14.43% and the error variance by 24.87%. These results demonstrate that the learned flow-based Jacobian field provides an effective local model for offline multi-step trajectory optimization in rigid-soft coupled nonlinear systems.
summary_zh: 受生物启发的腱驱动刚柔耦合灵巧手指具有强非线性和构型相关的灵敏度，这使得精确建模充满挑战。在离散时间控制中，基于雅可比矩阵的运动学算法通常依赖逐点局部线性近似，因此其性能对传感器采样频率和控制器更新频率较为敏感。为解决该问题，我们提出了雅可比流匹配（JFM）方法，这是一种基于条件流匹配（CFM）的结构化学习框架，用于学习具有分辨率一致性的雅可比场，将驱动到运动的转换建模为动力学流。所提出的框架同时支持单步预测和通过常微分方程（ODE）积分实现的连续滚动推演，从而在不同时间分辨率下实现一致的推断。在腱驱动刚柔耦合手指上的实验表明，所提方法能够抑制异常值误差并提升单步预测精度，与基线离散雅可比学习方法相比，全局平均均方根误差（RMSE）降低了53%以上。对于长时域预测，通过ODE积分恢复的轨迹在稀疏采样（步长 = 8）条件下具有更高的保真度，RMSE中位数降低了14.43%，误差方差降低了24.87%。这些结果表明，学习得到的基于流的雅可比场为刚柔耦合非线性系统中的离线多步轨迹优化提供了一种有效的局部模型。
tldr: This paper introduces Jacobian Flow Matching (JFM), a Conditional Flow Matching-based framework to learn a resolution-consistent Jacobian field for tendon-driven rigid-soft fingers, improving modeling accuracy and enabling consistent inference across temporal resolutions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了雅可比流匹配（JFM），一种基于条件流匹配的框架，用于学习腱驱动刚柔耦合手指的、分辨率一致的雅可比场，提高建模精度并实现跨时间分辨率的一致推理。

title: LiDARFlow: Real-Time Panel-Based MAV Guidance in Unknown Environments
summary: This paper presents a guidance algorithm for micro aerial vehicles operating in unknown, cluttered environments using only onboard sensing. The method is based on a panel formulation originally derived from aerodynamic potential-flow theory and generates smooth, collision-free guidance vectors from locally perceived obstacles. The approach is extended to unknown environments by constructing and updating the obstacle representation online from onboard LiDAR measurements. The resulting obstacle-avoidance field is integrated with a nominal guiding vector field to produce the final control input. The system is experimentally validated in indoor flight tests under two scenarios: waypoint navigation and directional guidance. In both cases, the vehicle successfully completes its task while avoiding all obstacles in real time using only onboard perception. The results demonstrate that the method is computationally lightweight and suitable for onboard implementation, with pointcloud processing identified as the main practical limitation. These results support the feasibility of lightweight onboard guidance in unknown environments.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种针对在未知、杂乱环境中仅依赖机载传感运行的微型飞行器的制导算法。该方法基于源自空气动力学势流理论的板元公式，利用局部感知的障碍物生成平滑、无碰撞的制导向量。通过从机载激光雷达测量数据在线构建并更新障碍物表示，该方法被扩展至未知环境。所生成的避障场与名义引导向量场相结合，产生最终的控制输入。该系统在室内飞行试验中进行了实验验证，涵盖两种场景：航点导航和方向引导。在两种情况下，飞行器均成功完成任务，并仅依靠机载感知实时避开所有障碍物。结果表明，该方法计算量小，适合机载实现，其中点云处理被识别为主要实际限制因素。这些结果支持了在未知环境中实现轻量化机载制导的可行性。
tldr: LiDARFlow presents a lightweight, real-time obstacle avoidance guidance algorithm for MAVs in unknown environments using onboard LiDAR, based on a panel formulation from aerodynamic potential-flow theory. The method is validated in indoor flight tests for waypoint navigation and directional guidance, showing computational efficiency with pointcloud processing as the main bottleneck.
tldr_zh: LiDARFlow提出了一种基于机载LiDAR的轻量级实时避障制导算法，适用于未知环境中的微型飞行器，该方法源于空气动力学势流理论的panel公式，并通过室内飞行实验验证了其在航点导航和定向引导中的有效性，计算效率高，主要瓶颈是点云处理。

title: Completion Aware Guidance for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) predict visual futures and robot actions, yet they remain susceptible to task-incomplete imagination, where plausible, action-consistent predictions omit the transition needed for task completion. In this paper, we show that this failure is not inherent to the world model backbone, but emerges when adapted for short-chunk control, which can repeatedly favor plausible local continuations over task-completing transitions. To address this, we introduce Completion Aware Guidance (CAG), a training-free sampling method that guides generation toward task completion. Across representative WAMs, CAG improves success from 64% to 70% on a RoboTwin 2.0 subset and from 69% to 75% in zero-shot simulation, while reducing task-incomplete imagination from 79% to 40%.
summary_zh: 世界行动模型（WAMs）能够预测视觉未来状态与机器人动作，然而它们仍易出现任务不完整想象的问题，即采用看似合理且与动作一致的预测时，却遗漏了完成任务所必需的过渡环节。在本文中，我们表明这一缺陷并非源于世界模型主干本身，而是在适配短片段控制时产生，这种控制方式会反复偏向于合理的局部延续，而非任务完成的过渡动作。为解决该问题，我们引入了完成感知引导（CAG），这是一种无需训练的采样方法，可将生成过程引导向任务完成方向。在具有代表性的WAMs上，CAG在RoboTwin 2.0子集中将成功率从64%提升至70%，在零样本模拟中从69%提升至75%，同时将任务不完整想象的比例从79%降低至40%。
tldr: This paper identifies task-incomplete imagination in World Action Models (WAMs) and proposes Completion Aware Guidance (CAG), a training-free sampling method that improves task completion success in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文指出了世界动作模型（WAM）中任务不完整想象的问题，并提出了一种无需训练的采样方法——完成感知引导（CAG），以提高仿真中任务完成的成功率。

title: ALFRED: Requirement-driven development of an open-source mobile manipulator for long-term plant monitoring
summary: Tracking seasonal change in crops and forests requires observing the same plants repeatedly. Ground robots can do this at close range, and a manipulator gives their sensors more viewpoints. Yet the robots behind long-term field datasets are rarely released with their design files, and how a robot's own structure limits arm reach and occludes its sensors is seldom compared between builds. We present ALFRED, an open-source mobile manipulator built from commercially available components. It carries a six-degree-of-freedom arm, LiDAR, RGB-D cameras, RTK GNSS and an IMU on an Ackermann-steered base, all mounted on a reconfigurable aluminium strut frame, and runs containerised ROS software. It was developed through four builds against six requirements for repeated outdoor deployment: durability, modularity, repairability, sensing reach, endurance and reproducibility. Model-based analysis of the last three builds shows the usable share of the arm's reachable poses rising from 34.0% to 60.0% and then 66.1%, and ray casting shows that only the final build keeps the frame-mounted LiDAR's horizontal view clear both forwards and backwards. ALFRED completed a year of monthly forest surveys (528 traversals) without missing a scheduled collection. This was despite battery degradation, reconfiguration for another researcher's study, and the parallel development of ALFRED 2.0 for autonomous crop-row operation, with each switch between builds taking about six hours. The deployment also showed that mechanical modularity is only as dependable as the robot description that tracks it.
summary_zh: 追踪农作物与森林的季节性变化需要对同一植株进行重复观测。地面机器人能够在近距离完成此类观测，而机械臂则为其传感器提供了更多视角。然而，长期野外数据集背后的机器人鲜少随设计文件一同发布，且机器人自身结构对机械臂可达范围的限制及对传感器的遮挡，也很少在不同构建之间进行对比。我们提出了ALFRED——一款基于商用部件构建的开源移动操作机器人。它搭载六自由度机械臂、激光雷达、RGB-D相机、RTK GNSS和IMU，安装于阿克曼转向底盘之上，全部集成于可重构的铝制型材框架中，并运行容器化的ROS软件。该机器人历经四次迭代构建，以满足六项重复野外部署需求：耐久性、模块化、可维修性、传感可达性、续航能力和可复现性。对后三次构建的基于模型的分析显示，机械臂可达姿态中可用比例从34.0%提升至60.0%，进而达到66.1%；光线投射分析则表明，只有最终构建能够确保框架安装的激光雷达在前后两个方向均保持水平视野无遮挡。ALFRED完成了为期一年的月度森林调查（共528次穿越），未遗漏任何一次计划采集。这一成果是在电池性能衰减、为其他研究人员的研究进行重新配置，以及并行开发用于自主作物行作业的ALFRED 2.0的背景下取得的，每次构建切换约需六小时。部署实践还表明，机械模块化的可靠性，取决于对其进行追踪的机器人描述文件的完善程度。
tldr: This paper presents ALFRED, an open-source mobile manipulator for long-term plant monitoring, developed through iterative requirement-driven design. It evaluates design improvements using model-based analysis and reports a year of successful field deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了ALFRED，一个用于长期植物监测的开源移动机械臂，通过迭代的、基于需求的设计进行开发。它使用基于模型的分析评估设计改进，并报告了一年的成功实地部署。

title: Is Success All You Need? Investigating the Impact of Input Perturbations on VLA Behaviour in Tabletop Manipulation Tasks
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved high task success rates on robot manipulation task benchmarks. More recently, there has been an emphasis on evaluating the robustness of VLA models to perturbations. However, this robustness is still predominantly measured through Task Success Rate (TSR). In this work, we propose a benchmark-agnostic evaluation framework to measure the behavioural robustness of models by characterising how successful trajectories are executed under perturbation. We implement this methodology by extending the widely-used LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks. Across three state-of-the-art VLA models, four LIBERO task suites and seven perturbation conditions, we evaluate changes in both typical successful behaviour and its variability, including metrics of motion smoothness, efficiency and gripper behaviour. We find that perturbations can alter the behaviour of successful trajectories, a phenomenon which cannot necessarily be inferred from TSR alone. Across LIBERO suites, we identify cases where state-of-the-art VLA models achieve comparable TSR under the same perturbation condition, yet behaviour on successful trajectories diverges substantially. Therefore, to have a more robust assessment of task performance, we argue that suitable measures of robustness should capture not only whether a task is completed, but also how the robot behaves while completing it. When evaluating the robustness of VLA models, TSR may be complemented by behavioural evaluation metrics that characterise the nature and variability of successful task execution by robots.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作任务基准测试中取得了较高的任务成功率。近期，评估VLA模型对扰动的鲁棒性日益受到重视。然而，这种鲁棒性目前仍主要通过任务成功率（TSR）来衡量。本研究提出了一种与基准无关的评估框架，通过刻画成功轨迹在扰动条件下的执行方式来衡量模型的行为鲁棒性。我们通过扩展广泛使用的LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus基准来实现该评估方法。针对三种最先进的VLA模型、四个LIBERO任务套件和七种扰动条件，我们评估了典型成功行为及其变异性的变化，包括运动平滑度、效率和夹爪行为等指标。研究发现，扰动会改变成功轨迹的行为特征，这一现象仅凭TSR可能无法推断出来。在LIBERO各任务套件中，我们发现了在相同扰动条件下，最先进的VLA模型达到了相当的TSR，但成功轨迹上的行为却存在显著差异的情况。因此，为了更全面地评估任务性能，我们认为合适的鲁棒性度量不仅应捕捉任务是否完成，还应反映机器人在完成任务过程中的行为方式。在评估VLA模型的鲁棒性时，TSR可辅以刻画机器人成功任务执行性质及变异性的行为评估指标。
tldr: This paper proposes a benchmark-agnostic evaluation framework for VLA models that measures behavioral robustness under input perturbations by analyzing how successful trajectories are executed, not just task success rate (TSR). Testing across LIBERO suites and perturbation conditions, it shows that perturbations alter successful behavior in ways not captured by TSR alone, advocating for complementary behavioral metrics in robustness evaluation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个与基准无关的VLA模型评估框架，通过分析扰动下成功轨迹的执行方式（而非仅任务成功率TSR）来衡量行为鲁棒性。在LIBERO套件和多种扰动条件下测试发现，扰动会改变成功行为，而TSR无法体现这一点，因此建议在鲁棒性评估中补充行为指标。

title: Continual Learning for 6-DoF Grasp Synthesis via Experience and Demonstrations
summary: Most current grasp synthesis systems are trained offline and remain fixed during deployment. While this works well when deployment conditions resemble the training data, performance can degrade when robots encounter conditions they have not seen before, such as unfamiliar objects. In this work, we present a continual-learning framework for single-view 6-DoF grasp synthesis for a parallel-jaw gripper in cluttered scenes. Rather than finetuning a large parametric model, our method adapts through memory in a learned embedding space: grasp outcomes update future grasp scores, while optional user demonstrations are recalled and transferred to new scenes as additional candidate grasps. We evaluate our method in simulation and in extensive real-world experiments comprising over 1500 grasp trials. We show that our method matches the performance of existing 6-DoF grasping baselines even before adaptation, improves online on unseen objects from categories absent or underrepresented during training, and supports long-horizon continual learning with limited forgetting. In real-world experiments, our method reaches over 90\% success rates on several challenging object categories after only 50 online grasp attempts. Videos and code at https://giuschio.github.io/cl_grasping/.
summary_zh: 大多数现有的抓取合成系统都是离线训练的，在部署期间固定不变。当初次部署条件与训练数据相似时，这类系统表现良好；但当机器人遇到此前未见过的条件（例如不熟悉的物体）时，性能可能会下降。在本研究中，我们提出了一种用于杂乱场景中平行夹爪的单视图六自由度抓取合成的连续学习框架。我们的方法并非微调大型参数化模型，而是通过在学习的嵌入空间中的记忆进行自适应：抓取结果更新未来的抓取得分，同时可选的用户演示会被回忆并作为额外的候选抓取迁移到新场景中。我们在仿真环境和广泛的真实世界实验中评估了该方法，涉及超过1500次抓取试验。结果表明，即使在自适应之前，我们的方法就与现有六自由度抓取基准方法的性能相当，并能在训练期间缺失或代表性不足的类别中未见物体上在线改进，同时支持带有限遗忘的长时程连续学习。在真实世界实验中，我们的方法在仅50次在线抓取尝试后，就在多个具有挑战性的物体类别上达到了超过90%的成功率。视频和代码见 https://giuschio.github.io/cl_grasping/。
tldr: This paper proposes a continual learning framework for 6-DoF grasp synthesis that adapts through memory in a learned embedding space, using grasp outcomes and optional user demonstrations, achieving over 90% success on novel objects after 50 real-world grasp attempts.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于6自由度抓取合成的持续学习框架，通过在学习到的嵌入空间中的记忆进行适应，利用抓取结果和可选的用户演示，在50次真实世界抓取尝试后，对新型物体实现了超过90%的成功率。

title: Interaction-Stiffness-Guided Basis Allocation in Dynamic Movement Primitives for Efficient Skill Transfer
summary: Dynamic Movement Primitives (DMPs) provide a compact and stable formulation for trajectory representation and generalization in robot skill learning. However, their predefined basis layout limits the allocation of approximation capacity according to stage-dependent precision requirements. To address this issue, this article proposes Stage-Criticality-Guided Dynamic Movement Primitives (SC-DMPs) with adaptive basis allocation for precision-critical skill learning. Operator-robot interaction stiffness and a trajectory-consistency cue derived from cross-demonstration task-space variability are integrated to construct a stage-criticality index. Guided by this index, basis centers are redistributed in normalized time through inverse cumulative criticality and mapped to the canonical phase domain, while their bandwidths are refined to adjust local approximation support. This enables denser and more flexible representation at high-criticality stages while retaining sparser allocation elsewhere. Experiments on handwriting trajectories and three real-robot tasks show that the inferred criticality is concentrated in geometrically demanding and task-constrained regions. Comparisons with DMPs, ProMPs, ProDMP, GP-MP, and KMP demonstrate improved trajectory reproduction, endpoint generalization, and task-critical accuracy while retaining a compact model and the stable structure of classical DMPs.
summary_zh: 动态运动原语（DMPs）为机器人技能学习中的轨迹表示与泛化提供了一种紧凑且稳定的框架。然而，其预定义的基函数布局限制了根据阶段相关精度要求分配逼近能力的能力。为解决该问题，本文提出了一种基于阶段关键性引导的自适应基函数分配动态运动原语（SC-DMPs），用于高精度关键技能学习。通过整合操作者-机器人交互刚度以及由跨示教任务空间变异性推导出的轨迹一致性线索，构建了阶段关键性指标。在该指标的引导下，基函数中心通过逆累积关键性在归一化时间上重新分布，并映射至规范相位域，同时对其带宽进行精细化调整以优化局部逼近支持范围。这使得在高关键性阶段能够实现更密集且更灵活的表示，同时在其他区域保持更稀疏的分配。在手写轨迹及三项真实机器人任务上的实验表明，所推断出的关键性集中于几何要求高及任务约束较强的区域。与DMPs、ProMPs、ProDMP、GP-MP及KMP的对比结果表明，所提方法在轨迹复现、端点泛化及任务关键精度方面均有所提升，同时保持了紧凑的模型结构以及经典DMPs的稳定框架。
tldr: This paper introduces Stage-Criticality-Guided Dynamic Movement Primitives (SC-DMPs) that adaptively allocate basis functions in DMPs based on interaction stiffness and trajectory consistency, improving precision-critical robot skill transfer and generalization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出阶段关键性引导的动态运动基元（SC-DMPs），根据交互刚度和轨迹一致性自适应分配基函数，以提高机器人技能迁移的精度和泛化能力。

title: Supervise What Decides Success: Criterion-Aligned Auxiliary Losses for Latent World-Model Planning
summary: Latent world models plan by scoring candidate action sequences with distances in latent space. However, task success is judged by physical quantities, which we call the success-criterion quantities. In all four latent world models we examine, the end-effector position is encoded in the latent state with an error larger than the success criterion allows. Such a latent state cannot separate successful candidates from failing ones. We propose an auxiliary loss that uses success-criterion quantities as training targets, whereas existing latent world models take them only as inputs. During training, a linear head on the encoder and predictor outputs regresses the success-criterion quantities, and the regression error is added to the training loss. The head is discarded after training, so the model, its cost, and its inputs at test time are unchanged. This loss alone improves the success rate on PushT and cube by 3.5% and 3.4% (absolute), respectively, and both improvements are statistically significant. A success criterion thus specifies what a world model must retain in its latent state, and we show that it can serve directly as a training target.
summary_zh: 潜在世界模型通过评估候选动作序列在潜在空间中的距离来进行规划。然而，任务的成功与否是由物理量判定的，我们称之为成功标准量。在我们考察的所有四种潜在世界模型中，末端执行器位置在潜在状态中的编码误差均大于成功标准所允许的范围。这样的潜在状态无法区分成功的候选与失败的候选。我们提出了一种辅助损失函数，将成功标准量作为训练目标，而现有的潜在世界模型仅将它们作为输入。在训练过程中，编码器和预测器输出上的线性头对成功标准量进行回归，回归误差被加入训练损失中。该线性头在训练后被丢弃，因此模型本身、其代价函数以及测试时的输入均保持不变。仅此损失函数即可将PushT和cube任务的成功率分别提高3.5%和3.4%（绝对值），且两项改进均具有统计显著性。因此，成功标准规定了世界模型必须在潜在状态中保留哪些信息，并且我们表明它可以直接作为训练目标使用。
tldr: This paper proposes an auxiliary loss that regresses success-criterion physical quantities from latent states of world models, improving planning success rates on PushT and cube tasks without changing test-time model cost or inputs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种辅助损失，用成功判定的物理量作为训练目标回归潜状态，在不改变测试时模型成本和输入的情况下，提升PushT和cube任务的成功率。

title: EIDA: Execution-Interface Dynamics Adaptation for Real-to-Sim-to-Real Robot Navigation
summary: Simulation-to-robot transfer can fail when velocity commands produce motion and feedback that differ from those modeled during policy training. We present execution-interface dynamics adaptation (EIDA), which fits these responses from target-platform execution data without reconstructing actuator dynamics. A model of body-frame pose increments updates simulator geometry, while a separate model predicts the velocity feedback observed by the policy; a short history of velocity feedback is included in the policy input. The fitted models are used within a lightweight GPU-parallel simulator. On the full Jackal and Go2 validation sets, the fitted models reduced position and yaw prediction errors relative to the simulator's predefined motion model. Across 100 benchmark navigation environments evaluated in a separate physics-based simulator, EIDA achieved the highest success rate and navigation score among the compared learned policies, both with and without global guidance. Feedback ablations further supported the need to match policy-facing velocity estimates. On a physical Unitree Go2, EIDA reached the goal without collision in all 20 static-scene trials, compared with 4 of 20 for the baseline. These results show that execution-interface adaptation can improve navigation transfer without detailed actuator simulation.
summary_zh: 仿真到机器人的迁移在速度指令产生的运动与反馈不同于策略训练期间建模的情况时可能会失败。我们提出了执行接口动力学适应（EIDA），该方法通过目标平台执行数据拟合这些响应，而无需重建执行器动力学。一个机体坐标系位姿增量模型用于更新仿真器几何，而另一个独立模型预测策略所观测到的速度反馈；策略输入中包含一段较短的速度反馈历史。拟合后的模型在轻量级GPU并行仿真器中使用。在完整的Jackal和Go2验证集上，拟合模型相较于仿真器预定义的运动模型，降低了位置和偏航角的预测误差。在另一个基于物理的仿真器中评估的100个基准导航环境中，EIDA在有无全局引导两种情况下，均取得了所比较的学习策略中最高的成功率和导航得分。反馈消融实验进一步支持匹配策略端速度估计的必要性。在实体Unitree Go2上，EIDA在全部20次静态场景试验中均无碰撞到达目标，而基线策略仅为20次中的4次。这些结果表明，执行接口适应无需详细的执行器仿真即可提升导航迁移效果。
tldr: EIDA adapts execution-interface dynamics in simulation to match real robot velocity commands and feedback, improving real-to-sim-to-real navigation transfer without detailed actuator modeling.
tldr_zh: EIDA调整模拟中的执行接口动力学，以匹配真实机器人的速度指令和反馈，从而提高真实-模拟-真实导航迁移效果，无需详细执行器建模。

title: AFD-CAMLs: Agile Force-Distribution-Aware Planning and Control for Cable-Suspended Aerial Multi-Lifting Systems
summary: Multiple UAVs can cooperatively transport heavy payloads while controlling their position and orientation. Trajectory-based methods offer high agility while satisfying system constraints, but can produce uneven force distributions when the tension-to-wrench allocation is redundant or ill-conditioned, particularly under geometric mismatch and low-level tracking errors. We propose a hybrid planning-and-control framework to address this problem. A global planner generates payload trajectories and cable-force references by exploring the allocation null space under a prescribed internal-force setting. These references augment the cost of a centralized local planner, promoting feasible force distributions while generating trajectories for all UAVs. An admittance filter then compares the planned forces with onboard cable-tension estimates and adjusts the kinematic references to improve force tracking in degenerate or near-degenerate configurations. Simulations and experiments involving four to ten UAVs demonstrate more balanced tension distributions during both hovering and demanding agile maneuvers, without compromising agility or payload-tracking performance.
summary_zh: 摘要：多架无人机可协同运输重型载荷，同时控制其位置和姿态。基于轨迹的方法能够在满足系统约束的同时实现高敏捷性，但当张力到力旋量的分配存在冗余或病态条件时，尤其是在几何失配和低级跟踪误差的情况下，可能会产生不均匀的力分布。我们提出了一种混合规划与控制框架来解决这一问题。全局规划器通过在预设内力设置下探索分配零空间来生成载荷轨迹和缆绳力参考。这些参考增强了集中式局部规划器的代价函数，在生成所有无人机轨迹的同时促进可行的力分布。随后，导纳滤波器将规划力与机载缆绳张力估计进行比较，并调整运动学参考，以改善退化或近退化构型中的力跟踪。涉及四至十架无人机的仿真和实验表明，在悬停和高要求敏捷机动过程中，张力分布更加均衡，且不影响敏捷性或载荷跟踪性能。
tldr: AFD-CAMLs proposes a hybrid planning-and-control framework for cable-suspended aerial multi-lifting systems that balances force distribution during agile maneuvers, validated on real UAVs.
tldr_zh: AFD-CAMLs提出了一种用于缆索悬挂式空中多吊装系统的混合规划与控制框架，在敏捷机动中平衡力的分布，并在真实无人机上验证。

title: PhysicsLENS: Diagnosing Physical Property Blindness in Video Generation Models
summary: Reliable video world models could provide scalable predictive environments for robot learning, planning, and evaluation. However, generated robot videos can violate physical principles and complete tasks through physically implausible behavior, limiting their reliability for robot learning and planning. Current video-generation benchmarks exclude physics that are inherently hidden by visuals (e.g., weight, viscosity, friction). Due to this, video models are evaluated on the fidelity of physics, not the underlying accuracy of physics. We introduce PhysicsLENS, a dataset and benchmark for evaluating plausibility of physical properties grounded in robotics. PhysicsLENS uses matched scenario pairs that hold the same conditioning frame and task, while varying underlying physics in the scene description. Scenarios are curated from public robot video sources and annotated across seven physical domains: collision, gravity, momentum, friction, deformation, fluid, and causality. We evaluate across four video generation models, producing over 400 human-annotated labels. Results show that plausible-looking videos often ignore the stated property (34 of 47), and that stating the property lowers plausibility only slightly and not significantly.
summary_zh: 可靠的视频世界模型能够为机器人学习、规划与评估提供可扩展的预测环境。然而，生成的机器人视频可能违反物理原理，并通过物理上不切实际的行为来完成任务，这限制了其在机器人学习和规划中的可靠性。当前的视频生成基准排除了视觉上天然隐藏的物理特性（例如重量、黏度、摩擦力）。因此，视频模型评估的是物理表现的真实感，而非物理本身的准确性。我们引入了PhysicsLENS，一个基于机器人技术、用于评估物理属性合理性的数据集和基准。PhysicsLENS采用匹配的场景对，这些场景对在保持相同条件帧和任务的同时，改变场景描述中的底层物理属性。场景选自公开的机器人视频源，并在七个物理领域进行标注：碰撞、重力、动量、摩擦、形变、流体和因果性。我们评估了四种视频生成模型，生成了超过400个人工标注标签。结果表明，表面上合理的视频常常忽略所陈述的物理属性（47例中有34例），且陈述物理属性仅略微降低合理性，且降低幅度不显著。
tldr: PhysicsLENS introduces a benchmark and dataset for evaluating video generation models' ability to represent hidden physical properties (e.g., weight, viscosity, friction) using matched scenario pairs from robot videos, finding that models often ignore stated properties while producing plausible-looking videos.
tldr_zh: PhysicsLENS 提出了一个基准和数据集，通过来自机器人视频的匹配场景对来评估视频生成模型表示隐藏物理属性（如重量、粘度、摩擦力）的能力，发现模型往往忽略指定属性但生成看似合理的视频。

title: MASkillBlender: Decentralized Whole-Body Coordination for Multi-Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Skill Blending
summary: Coordinated multi-humanoid loco-manipulation is promising yet challenging due to high-dimensional whole-body control, decentralized decision making, and scalability. While recent reinforcement learning methods have improved single-humanoid whole-body control, extending them to the multi-humanoid setting remains nontrivial and often requires substantial reward engineering or task-specific design. We propose MASkillBlender, a general multi-agent reinforcement learning framework to achieve decentralized multi-humanoid whole-body coordination. By learning a shared decentralized high-level policy over reusable pre-trained single-humanoid skills, MASkillBlender enables coordinated behaviors using only task-level rewards, without requiring task-specific motion references. To improve learning efficiency, we further introduce a permutation-based data augmentation strategy for homogeneous multi-humanoid systems, and theoretically show that the permuted samples preserve the policy-gradient direction of the original samples under the homogeneous Markov game formulation. We evaluate MASkillBlender on multiple multi-humanoid coordination tasks across two humanoid embodiments. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently achieves strong task performance and enables coordinated behaviors across different tasks and humanoid embodiments.
summary_zh: 协调多仿人机器人操作极具前景但也充满挑战，这源于其高维全身控制、分散式决策以及可扩展性问题。尽管近期强化学习方法已提升了单仿人机器人的全身控制能力，但将其扩展至多仿人机器人场景仍非易事，且通常需要大量的奖励工程设计或针对特定任务的定制方案。我们提出了MASkillBlender，一种通用多智能体强化学习框架，旨在实现分散式多仿人机器人全身协调。通过学习一个共享的分散式高层策略，并复用于可预训练的单仿人机器人技能，MASkillBlender仅需任务级奖励即可实现协调行为，无需依赖任务特定的运动参考。为提高学习效率，我们进一步针对同构多仿人机器人系统引入了一种基于置换的数据增强策略，并从理论上证明，在同构马尔可夫博弈框架下，置换样本保持了原始样本的策略梯度方向。我们在多种多仿人机器人协调任务上评估了MASkillBlender，涵盖两种仿人机器人外形。仿真结果表明，所提出的框架在不同任务和仿人机器人外形下均能稳定取得良好的任务表现，并实现协调行为。
tldr: MASkillBlender proposes a decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that blends reusable pre-trained single-humanoid skills to enable coordinated multi-humanoid loco-manipulation, using only task-level rewards and a permutation-based augmentation strategy.
tldr_zh: MASkillBlender 提出了一种去中心化的多智能体强化学习框架，通过融合可复用的预训练单个人形机器人技能，实现多个人形机器人的协调操作，仅需任务级奖励，并采用基于排列的数据增强策略。

title: quARtet Marker: A 3D-Printable Multi-Tag Fiducial for Robust Near-Frontal Pose Estimation
summary: Robotic manipulation of labware is difficult when transparent or reflective objects must be identified and localized. Coded planar fiducials are a practical retrofit: easy to print, they leave the marked face flat and graspable. Yet a single planar tag is least reliable in near-frontal views, where perspective cues fade. Non-planar geometries restore those cues but intrude on the flat face that a parallel-jaw gripper must contact. Our idea is to tilt multiple tags within one compact footprint, so that each tag is seen at a non-frontal angle even when the marker faces the camera. We propose the quARtet marker, a 3D-printable fiducial embodying this idea: all detected corners of its four tilted AprilTags enter one Perspective-n-Point solve, and a shared configuration defines the fabricated geometry and the detector model. Because tilting consumes flat area, its three layouts trade pose-estimation consistency against graspability. In robot-referenced, same-setup fixed-camera experiments, all three layouts reduced the mean frontal orientation error from 2.18 degree for a single planar tag to 0.24-0.47 degree and the root-mean-square position error from 1.50 to 0.17-0.20 mm. A robot-mounted-camera pose-hold test confirmed this separation under closed-loop visual feedback. In swing-down trials under identical conditions, the two layouts with flat contact strips retained the object with about 2 mm of in-grasp slip, whereas the layout without flat strips slipped by roughly 100 mm. For the tested conditions, the results support a rule: the layout without flat strips when pose-estimation consistency dominates, a layout with flat strips when the marked face must remain graspable.
summary_zh: 对透明或反光物体进行识别与定位时，实验室器皿的机器人操控存在较大难度。编码平面基准标记是一种实用的改造方案：易于打印，且能使标记面保持平整并可供抓取。然而，在近乎正面的视角下，单个平面标签的可靠性最低，因为此时透视线索减弱。非平面几何结构能够恢复这些线索，但会侵占平行爪夹爪必须接触的平面表面。我们的思路是在一个紧凑的占用区域内倾斜多个标签，使得即使标记正对相机，每个标签也能以非正面角度被观测到。我们提出了quARtet标记，这是一种 embodying 这一理念的3D打印基准标记：其四个倾斜AprilTag检测到的所有角点均参与一次透视n点求解，且共享配置同时定义了制造几何与检测模型。由于倾斜会消耗平面面积，其三种布局在姿态估计一致性与可抓取性之间进行权衡。在与机器人参考系一致、固定相机的同设置实验中，三种布局均将平均正面朝向误差从单个平面标签的2.18度降至0.24至0.47度，并将位置误差的均方根从1.50毫米降至0.17至0.20毫米。机器人搭载相机的位姿保持测试在闭环视觉反馈下进一步确认了上述分离效果。在相同条件下的下摆试验中，两种带有平面接触条的布局保持了约2毫米的抓取内滑动，而无平面接触条的布局则滑动了约100毫米。在测试条件下，实验结果支持以下规则：当姿态估计一致性占主导时选用无平面接触条的布局；当标记面需保持可抓取性时选用带平面接触条的布局。
tldr: The paper introduces quARtet, a 3D-printable fiducial marker with four tilted AprilTags, which significantly improves pose estimation accuracy and graspability for transparent or reflective labware in near-frontal views, demonstrating effectiveness in real robot experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种3D打印的多标签基准标记物quARtet，通过倾斜四个AprilTag提高近正面视角下透明或反光实验室器皿的位姿估计精度和可抓取性，并在真实机器人实验中验证了其有效性。

title: A Survey on End-to-End Autonomous Driving Training from the Perspectives of Data, Strategy, and Platform
summary: Autonomous driving is a cornerstone technology for the future of intelligent transportation, where end-to-end learning has emerged as a transformative paradigm that directly maps multimodal sensory inputs to driving actions through unified differentiable models. While offering advantages, the effectiveness of end-to-end autonomous driving (E2E-AD) is ultimately determined by the quality of its training ecosystem. This paper provides a comprehensive review of training methods and ecosystem for E2E-AD. We introduce a Data-Strategy-Platform taxonomy that conceptualizes training as an interdependent system. The data layer defines what can be learned, the strategy layer governs how learning aligns with driving objectives, and the platform layer supports scalability and continuous evolution. Within this framework, we survey recent advances across data-centric pipelines, learning paradigms, and training infrastructures, and analyze their interplay in shaping model performance, robustness, and deployability. Finally, we reflect on current limitations and articulate a forward-looking vision that emphasizes a shift from data quantity to data value, from isolated optimization to foundation-driven generalization, and from static training to integrated training-testing loops, aiming toward robust, scalable, and trustworthy autonomous driving systems. We maintain a continuously updated repository tracking cutting-edge literature and works at \href{https://github.com/Jiaaqiliu/Awesome-Training-Ecosystem-for-E2E-AD}{Our Project Page}.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶是未来智能交通的基石技术，其中端到端学习作为一种变革性范式应运而生，通过统一的可微模型直接将多模态感知输入映射为驾驶动作。尽管端到端自动驾驶（E2E-AD）具备诸多优势，其有效性最终取决于训练生态系统的质量。本文对端到端自动驾驶的训练方法与生态系统进行了全面综述。我们提出了一种“数据-策略-平台”分类体系，将训练视为一个相互依存的系统整体。其中，数据层定义了可学习的内容，策略层支配学习如何与驾驶目标对齐，而平台层则为可扩展性与持续演进提供支撑。在该框架下，我们系统梳理了数据驱动流水线、学习范式与训练基础设施方面的最新进展，并分析了它们之间在塑造模型性能、鲁棒性与可部署性方面的相互作用。最后，我们反思了当前存在的局限性，并展望了未来发展方向，强调从数据数量转向数据价值、从孤立优化走向基于基础模型的泛化、从静态训练迈向训练-测试一体化闭环，以构建稳健、可扩展且值得信赖的自动驾驶系统。我们持续维护一个不断更新的资源库，跟踪前沿文献与相关工作，详见我们的项目页面：\href{https://github.com/Jiaaqiliu/Awesome-Training-Ecosystem-for-E2E-AD}{项目主页}。
tldr: This paper provides a comprehensive survey of end-to-end autonomous driving training, organizing recent advances into a Data-Strategy-Platform taxonomy and offering a forward-looking vision for robust, scalable, and trustworthy systems.
tldr_zh: 本文对端到端自动驾驶训练进行了全面综述，将最新进展组织为数据-策略-平台分类法，并提出面向鲁棒、可扩展和可信系统的前瞻性愿景。

title: Lang3DSeg: Annotation-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Segmentation with Point Transformers
summary: Accurate 3D semantic perception is critical for safe autonomous navigation. However, supervised LiDAR segmentation remains tied to closed taxonomies and to the cost of point-wise manual annotation. Open-vocabulary methods avoid that cost by projecting the output of 2D vision-language models onto LiDAR and distilling it into a 3D network. These methods rely almost exclusively on voxel-based sparse convolutions, and point transformers have so far been limited to indoor environments, where 3D data is dense and bounded. We present Lang3DSeg, which establishes a point transformer as the backbone for annotation-free open-vocabulary segmentation of outdoor 3D LiDAR, and is trained from scratch without geometric pre-training. This training paradigm necessitates addressing the inherent noise in 2D-to-3D label projections; specifically, naive projection often suffers from depth ambiguity, where points behind an object are erroneously assigned its semantic label. We therefore composite masks using an explicit class-priority rule and truncate each projected instance at the first gap in its depth distribution, correcting the projection error directly rather than averaging it over registered sequences. Lang3DSeg achieves 52.8% mIoU on nuScenes validation and 41.4% on SemanticKITTI, the highest among published annotation-free methods on both benchmarks. Every 3D semantic segmentation is on a single LiDAR sweep, and inference operates in real-time without running vision-language models.
summary_zh: 精确的三维语义感知对安全的自主导航至关重要。然而，受监督的激光雷达分割仍受限于封闭的分类体系以及逐点人工标注的成本。开放词汇方法通过将二维视觉-语言模型的输出投影到激光雷达数据上，并将其蒸馏至三维网络中，从而避免了这一成本。这些方法几乎完全依赖基于体素的空间卷积，而点变换器迄今仅限于室内环境，在室内环境中三维数据密集且有界。我们提出了Lang3DSeg，其将点变换器确立为无标注室外三维激光雷达开放词汇分割的主干网络，并在无几何预训练的情况下从零开始训练。这一训练范式要求应对二维到三维标签投影中固有的噪声；具体而言，朴素投影常遭受深度模糊问题，即物体后方的点被错误地赋予该物体的语义标签。因此，我们利用显式的类别优先级规则合成掩码，并在每个投影实例的深度分布首次间隙处进行截断，直接纠正投影误差，而非在配准序列上对其进行平均化处理。Lang3DSeg在nuScenes验证集上达到52.8%的mIoU，在SemanticKITTI上达到41.4%，在两个基准上均为已发表无标注方法中的最高水平。所有三维语义分割均基于单次激光雷达扫描，且推理无需运行视觉-语言模型即可实时运行。
tldr: Lang3DSeg introduces a point transformer backbone for annotation-free open-vocabulary 3D LiDAR segmentation, corrected projection noise via depth-gap truncation and class-priority mask compositing, and achieves state-of-the-art real-time results on nuScenes and SemanticKITTI.
tldr_zh: Lang3DSeg 提出将点Transformer用于无标注开放词汇的室外LiDAR三维分割，通过深度间隙截断和类别优先掩码组合修正投影噪声，在nuScenes和SemanticKITTI上取得最先进实时结果。

title: TRACE: Privacy-Preserving Next-Best-View Selection over Distributed 3D Gaussian-Splat Maps
summary: Share the light, not the map. We study next-best-view selection for a team of robots, each of which builds its own 3D Gaussian Splatting map and keeps it private. A robot picks the view with the largest expected information gain (EIG) about the splats along its own path. This gain depends on the other maps. Their splats occlude its own and shine behind them, so the gain has to be evaluated against the pooled map. No robot has this map. We show that the coupling passes through only two ray quantities, the transmittance in front of a splat and the radiance behind it, and that both are sums over the hits of the ray. Hence, they decompose across the robots, and each robot sums them over depth bins in its own map, along the rays of a candidate view, and sends the sums with their pose derivatives. The robot planning the view turns them into its EIG and gradient on SO(3). Transmittance and Radiance Aggregates, communicated for the EIG, give the protocol its name: TRACE. No robot shares its splats, and the message size does not grow with a map. We prove that the reconstruction is exact unless a depth bin behind a splat mixes hits of two robots, and we bound the error otherwise. Over 100 next-best-view decisions in Habitat-Sim, TRACE picks a heading within 15 degrees of the centralized one in 83.3% of the cases, and its views reach 97.9% of the centralized EIG.
summary_zh: 分享光线，而非地图。我们研究了一组机器人团队的下一最佳视角选择问题，每个机器人各自构建自己的三维高斯溅射地图并对其保密。机器人沿其自身路径选择对溅射具有最大期望信息增益（EIG）的视角。该增益依赖于其他地图。其他机器人的溅射会遮挡自身溅射并在其后方发光，因此增益必须针对合并后的地图进行评估。没有任何机器人拥有这一合并地图。我们证明，这种耦合仅通过两个光线量传递，即溅射前方的透射率和其后方的辐射度，且两者均为光线命中次数的总和。因此，它们可跨机器人分解，每个机器人沿候选视角的光线在其自身地图的深度区间内求和，并将这些和连同其姿态导数一并发送。规划视角的机器人将其转换为SO(3)上的EIG及梯度。为EIG通信的透射率与辐射度聚合体，赋予该协议以名称：TRACE。没有机器人共享其溅射，且消息大小不随地图增长。我们证明，除非溅射后方的深度区间混合了两个机器人的命中，否则重建是精确的，否则我们界定误差范围。在Habitat-Sim中进行的100次下一最佳视角决策中，TRACE在83.3%的情况下选择的航向与集中式方法相差在15度以内，其视角达到了集中式EIG的97.9%。
tldr: This paper introduces TRACE, a protocol for privacy-preserving next-best-view selection in multi-robot 3D Gaussian Splatting mapping, where each robot keeps its map private and only shares aggregated ray quantities to compute information gain, achieving near-centralized performance at reduced communication cost.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了TRACE协议，用于多机器人3D高斯溅射建图中的隐私保护下一最佳视角选择，各机器人保持地图私有，仅共享聚合光线量以计算信息增益，以较低通信成本达到接近集中式的性能。

title: Measuring Asset and Scene Reconstruction Effects in Real-to-Sim Robot Evaluation
summary: Simulated evaluation is increasingly used alongside real-world evaluation of robot policies because it is cheaper and easier to repeat; however, its value depends on how closely its outcomes track the real robot's. We test whether our reconstruction pipeline, combining metrically scaled object geometry, authored physical parameters and scene reconstruction, reduces disagreement between simulated and real robot scores relative to a default open-source recipe. We constructed two simulated versions of one bimanual robot cell: an authored reconstruction, using object geometry at estimated metric scale, projected textures, authored physics and our own scene splat; and a baseline, referred to as the default reconstruction, using the open-source recipe of a generative single-image mesh, engine-default physics and a Gaussian-splat scene. Both reconstructions use the same object photographs and scene video. Two policies ran five tasks each, giving ten task-policy pairs, which we call cells; each cell was run twenty times in each reconstruction with all other settings held fixed. Both reconstructions were scored against the same real trials, graded by a third-party evaluator. Pearson correlation between the ten simulated and real cell means is r = 0.90 for the authored reconstruction and 0.51 for the default. Mean score error is 6.97 percentage points for the authored reconstruction and 17.54 for the default, a reduction of 10.56 percentage points. These results show that improving the quality of the environment reconstruction through higher visual fidelity, authored physics and metric scale makes the simulation more faithful to the real world and narrows the sim-to-real gap. We release the harness, the per-trial scores, every reported run's configuration, and the assets and scenes of both reconstructions.
summary_zh: 模拟评估越来越多地与真实世界中的机器人策略评估结合使用，因为它成本更低且更易于重复；然而，其价值取决于模拟结果在多大程度上与真实机器人的表现相一致。我们测试了我们的重建流程——结合度量尺度的物体几何、作者设定的物理参数以及场景重建——是否能相对于默认的开源方案，减少模拟与真实机器人评分之间的差异。我们构建了一个双臂机器人单元的两个模拟版本：一个是作者重建版本，使用估计度量尺度下的物体几何、投影纹理、作者设定的物理参数以及我们自己的场景高斯溅射；另一个是基线版本，称为默认重建，采用生成式单图像网格的开源方案、引擎默认物理以及高斯溅射场景。两种重建使用相同的物体照片和场景视频。两个策略分别执行了五项任务，构成了十组任务-策略对，我们称之为单元；每个单元在每种重建中运行二十次，所有其他设置保持不变。两种重建均与相同的真实试验进行评分对比，评分由第三方评估者完成。十组模拟与真实单元均值之间的皮尔逊相关系数，在作者重建版本中为r = 0.90，在默认版本中为0.51。平均评分误差在作者重建版本中为6.97个百分点，在默认版本中为17.54个百分点，降低了10.56个百分点。这些结果表明，通过更高的视觉保真度、作者设定的物理参数和度量尺度来提高环境重建质量，能使模拟更贴近真实世界，并缩小模拟到真实的差距。我们发布了测试框架、逐次试验评分、所有报告的运行配置，以及两种重建的资产和场景。
tldr: This paper evaluates a real-to-sim reconstruction pipeline for robot evaluation, showing that higher-fidelity reconstructed environments (authored geometry, physics, scene splat) improve sim-to-real correlation and reduce score error compared to a default open-source recipe.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了一种用于机器人评估的真实到仿真重建流程，表明更高保真度的重建环境（建模几何、物理、场景splat）相比默认开源方案能提高仿真与真实的相关性并减小分数误差。

title: Toward Humanoid Robots in Construction: A Teleoperation Feasibility Study
summary: We present a teleoperation system that enables a single operator to perform construction tasks on a Unitree G1 humanoid, combining extended reality (XR) based upper body control with pedal-based locomotion to enable simultaneous manipulation and locomotion. Motivated by persistent labor shortages, hazardous working conditions, and challenges in humanoid autonomy, we investigate teleoperation as a practical near-term approach for reducing physical strain on workers while generating high quality demonstration data. We evaluate the system on two representative construction tasks drawn from O*NET occupational database, and report task success and completion time relative to a manual baseline. The system achieved 100% success on tool transport and 80% success on surface painting, with teleoperation requiring substantially more time compared to manual execution.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种遥操作系统，使单一操作员能够控制Unitree G1人形机器人执行建筑施工任务，该系统将基于扩展现实（XR）的上半身控制与基于踏板的移动控制相结合，实现操作与移动的同步进行。鉴于建筑业持续存在的劳动力短缺、危险工作条件以及人形机器人自主性方面的挑战，我们探索将遥操作作为一种近期可行的实用方案，以减轻工人的身体负担，同时生成高质量的演示数据。我们以O*NET职业数据库中的两项代表性施工任务为基准对系统进行了评估，并报告了相对于手动基线标准的任务成功率与完成时间。该系统在工具搬运任务中实现了100%的成功率，在表面喷涂任务中实现了80%的成功率，但遥操作所需时间显著长于手动执行。
tldr: This paper presents a teleoperation system for a Unitree G1 humanoid robot using XR-based upper body control and pedal-based locomotion, and evaluates it on two construction tasks, achieving high success but slower times than manual execution.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于Unitree G1人形机器人的遥操作系统，结合基于XR的上半身控制和踏板式运动，并在两项建筑任务上进行了评估，成功率较高但耗时多于手动操作。

title: Learning Transferable Skills using Goal-Conditioned Bisimulation
summary: Unsupervised skill discovery has emerged as a promising approach for leveraging reward-free datasets to pretrain general-purpose policies. However, current skill discovery methods either require access to expert data or exhibit limited generalization, failing to transfer effectively to previously unseen layouts. A key challenge is to learn representations that capture the temporal structure of the environment while remaining robust to variations across layouts. To address this issue, we present an objective for learning action-aware temporal representations that satisfy the functional equivariance property while preserving the local temporal structure of the environment. Building upon this embedding, we further propose unsupervised skill discovery using bisimulation, which learns transferable skills by conditioning the behavior of skills exclusively on the subset of state features that directly affect their execution. This enforces invariant behavior across different layouts, enabling skills to transfer effectively to other configurations. Finally, through comprehensive empirical evaluations, we show that skills learned in a given environment can be effectively applied to solve downstream tasks in various environment layouts, demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization.
summary_zh: 无监督技能发现已成为利用无奖励数据集预训练通用策略的一种有前景的方法。然而，现有的技能发现方法要么需要访问专家数据，要么表现出有限的泛化能力，无法有效迁移到未见过的布局中。一个关键挑战在于学习能够捕捉环境时间结构、同时对不同布局之间的变化保持鲁棒性的表示。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种学习动作感知时间表示的目标函数，该表示满足函数等变性，同时保留环境的局部时间结构。在此嵌入的基础上，我们进一步提出了基于双模拟的无监督技能发现方法，通过仅将技能行为条件化于直接影响其执行的状�态特征子集，来学习可迁移的技能。这确保了不同布局之间行为的不变性，使技能能够有效迁移到其他配置中。最后，通过全面的实证评估，我们展示了在给定环境中习得的技能能够有效应用于解决各种环境布局中的下游任务，展现出强大的分布外泛化能力。
tldr: This paper introduces a bisimulation-based objective for unsupervised skill discovery that learns action-aware temporal representations and produces transferable skills conditioned on state features affecting skill execution, enabling strong out-of-distribution generalization to unseen layouts in downstream tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于双模仿真的目标函数用于无监督技能发现，学习动作感知的时间表征，并使技能仅依据影响其执行的状态特征进行条件化，从而在不同布局间实现强泛化。
