title: Does Continual Imitation Learning Remain Grounded? A Language-Perturbed Benchmark for Robotic Task Retention
summary: Continual imitation learning evaluates whether a robot can learn new knowledge without forgetting previously learned skills. However, retaining task performance does not ensure the behavior remains grounded in language because policies may rely on scene cues, object associations, or memorized task structure. We introduce a benchmark protocol to study how language-guided behavior changes as robotic policies learn successive tasks. We construct meaning-preserving and meaning-changing instruction variants for the Goal, Spatial, Object, and Long suites of LIBERO. Policy experiments focus on LIBERO-Goal, evaluating Original and Paraphrase instructions after each continual-learning stage. We compare representative continual imitation learning methods under their original assumptions while separating task competence from language sensitivity. The proposed diagnostics complement standard learning and forgetting metrics by measuring semantic robustness, goal adaptation, and language sensitivity. Results show that strong continual-learning performance does not always translate to reliable language grounding, and our diagnostics help determine whether retained skills remain correctly guided by their instructions. Additional materials are available at https://sites.google.com/view/stillgrounded
summary_zh: 持续模仿学习评估机器人在不遗忘已学技能的前提下学习新知识的能力。然而，保持任务性能并不能确保行为仍然扎根于语言，因为策略可能依赖场景线索、物体关联或记忆中的任务结构。我们引入了一套基准测试协议，以研究当机器人策略学习连续任务时，语言引导行为如何变化。我们针对LIBERO的Goal、Spatial、Object和Long套件构建了保持意义和改变意义的指令变体。策略实验聚焦于LIBERO-Goal，在每一个持续学习阶段后评估原始指令和改写指令。我们在保持其原始假设的条件下比较了具有代表性的持续模仿学习方法，同时将任务能力与语言敏感性分离。所提出的诊断指标通过测量语义鲁棒性、目标适应性和语言敏感性，补充了标准的学习与遗忘度量。结果表明，较强的持续学习性能并不总能转化为可靠的语言基础，而我们的诊断有助于判断保留的技能是否仍能被其指令正确引导。附加材料可在 https://sites.google.com/view/stillgrounded 获取。
tldr: This paper introduces a benchmark protocol to evaluate whether continual imitation learning on LIBERO retains language-grounded behavior, showing that strong task retention does not guarantee semantic robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个基准协议，用于评估 LIBERO 上的持续模仿学习是否保持语言引导行为，表明强大的任务保留并不保证语义鲁棒性。

title: ScaffoldM3C: A Multimodal Sequential Monte Carlo Framework for Generative Stable Construction Planning
summary: Autonomously constructing physically realizable 3D structures remains a significant challenge due to combinatorial action spaces, interchangeable components, equifinal assembly sequences, and strict stability requirements during construction. State-of-the-art methods fine-tune large language models for text-based generative construction. However, these approaches do not allow for Multimodal (text, image, sketch) conditioning, overlook the practical role of scaffolding for stabilizing intermediate structures, and suffer from slow inference speeds. Therefore, we formulate construction as a probabilistic next-block generation task with multiple potential assembly actions and multiple potential task conditioning modalities. Concurrently, we explicitly consider the utility of scaffolding by introducing an auxiliary scaffold block token. We present Scaffold Multimodal Monte Carlo (ScaffoldM3C), a multimodal, lightweight, auto-regressive model for stable block-based construction, that proposes a set of next-step candidate blocks. Leveraging these candidates, we utilize Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) to maintain a population of possible assembly sequences, allowing us to consider multiple, potentially different, assembly directions simultaneously. We train our multimodal architecture by extending the StableText2Brick dataset to contain image conditioning prompts and scaffold-stabilized build sequences. ScaffoldM3C is 4x smaller than competing baselines, yielding a 5x to 20x speedup during inference, while achieving comparable construction quality to state-of-the-art methods and higher overall stability. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach through simulations and real-world robot assembly demonstrations.
summary_zh: 自主构建物理上可实现的三维结构仍是一项重大挑战，原因在于组合动作空间、可互换组件、等效装配序列以及施工过程中的严格稳定性要求。现有最先进的方法通过微调大型语言模型来实现基于文本的生成式构建。然而，这些方法不支持多模态（文本、图像、草图）条件输入，忽视了脚手架在稳定中间结构中的实际作用，且推理速度较慢。因此，我们将构建任务形式化为具有多种潜在装配动作和多种潜在任务条件模态的概率性下一模块生成任务。同时，我们通过引入辅助的脚手架模块标记来明确考虑脚手架的效用。我们提出了Scaffold Multimodal Monte Carlo（ScaffoldM3C），一种用于稳定模块化构建的多模态轻量级自回归模型，该模型提出一组下一步候选模块。利用这些候选模块，我们采用序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）方法维护一组可能的装配序列，从而能够同时考虑多个可能不同方向的装配路径。我们通过扩展StableText2Brick数据集（增加图像条件提示和脚手架稳定的构建序列）来训练我们的多模态架构。ScaffoldM3C的规模比竞争基线模型小4倍，推理速度提升5倍至20倍，同时构建质量与最先进方法相当，整体稳定性更高。我们通过仿真和真实机器人装配演示验证了该方法的效果。
tldr: ScaffoldM3C introduces a multimodal, lightweight autoregressive model with Sequential Monte Carlo for stable block-based construction, supporting text/image/sketch conditioning and scaffold tokens, enabling faster and more stable assembly in simulation and real robots.
tldr_zh: ScaffoldM3C 提出了一种多模态轻量级自回归模型，结合顺序蒙特卡洛方法用于稳定的积木式构建，支持文本/图像/草图条件输入和脚手架标记，在仿真和真实机器人上实现了更快速、更稳定的组装。

title: Iterative Policy Refinement through Semantic Rollout Analysis
summary: Structured policies improve efficiency, robustness, and interpretability in imitation learning by introducing task-specific inductive bias, but existing structure generation methods rely either on extensive human input or on static domain knowledge encoded in LLMs, which may be inconsistent with the expert demonstrations. We propose a closed-loop framework that iteratively refines structured policies using LLM-guided analysis of policy rollouts. By logging rollouts as semantically meaningful tabular data and prompting the LLM to generate diagnostic analysis code, our method identifies suboptimalities in the policy structure and iteratively corrects them without requiring human instruction. Experiments on car racing and door opening tasks show that our approach improves imitation learning performance by up to 15% over zero-shot LLM-generated structures and requires 75% less compute to achieve the same reinforcement learning performance. These results demonstrate that tabular rollout analysis provides an effective feedback signal to align LLM-generated policy structures with expert demonstrations, and we can utilize it to generate good policy structures automatically.
summary_zh: 结构化策略通过在模仿学习中引入任务特定的归纳偏置，提升了效率、鲁棒性和可解释性，但现有的结构生成方法要么依赖大量人工输入，要么依赖编码在大语言模型中的静态领域知识，这些知识可能与专家示范不一致。我们提出了一种闭环框架，利用大语言模型对策略回滚的分析来迭代优化结构化策略。通过将回滚记录为语义上有意义的表格数据，并提示大语言模型生成诊断分析代码，我们的方法能够识别策略结构中的次优之处，并在无需人工指导的情况下迭代修正。在赛车和开门任务上的实验表明，与零样本大语言模型生成的结构相比，我们的方法将模仿学习性能提升了最高15%，同时在达到相同强化学习性能时计算量减少了75%。这些结果表明，表格回滚分析提供了一种有效的反馈信号，能够使大语言模型生成的策略结构与专家示范对齐，并且我们可以利用该信号自动生成优质策略结构。
tldr: This paper introduces a closed-loop framework that uses LLM-generated diagnostic analysis of semantically meaningful tabular rollout data to iteratively refine structured policies for imitation learning, improving performance by up to 15% over zero-shot LLM structures and reducing compute by 75%.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种闭环框架，利用LLM对语义化表格回滚数据生成诊断分析代码，迭代优化模仿学习的结构化策略，相比零样本LLM结构性能提升达15%，计算量减少75%。

title: Measuring the Stability Assumption Behind Action Chunking
summary: Action chunking improves the performance of policies learned by behavioural cloning, and several mechanisms have been proposed to explain why, including temporal consistency, horizon reduction, representation learning, and reduced error compounding. We instead study what happens to an action error once it enters the system. At each state, we inject a small action error and measure how fast it grows or shrinks under two execution regimes: open-loop, where the rest of the chunk is replayed without replanning, and closed-loop, where the policy replans after the perturbation. The fitted rate labels each state as contracting, expanding, or unresolved. Across twelve manipulation tasks from three benchmark suites, we find that confidently stable states are rare, while error amplification is common among states whose propagation rate can be resolved. We further find that the measured propagation rate depends strongly on the fitting horizon: amplification is typically front-loaded, so short windows can overestimate longer-horizon propagation. Finally, we train predictors on these labels and find that a state's open-loop regime can be recovered from camera frames and proprioception alone, while its closed-loop propagation is only partially recoverable because it also depends on how the policy acts after the perturbation. These results suggest that error-compounding arguments alone do not provide a complete account of action chunking: neither passive open-loop dynamics nor policy replanning consistently contracts an injected error, and replanning rarely turns open-loop amplification into confident contraction. This suggests that closed-loop reactivity should be trained explicitly, using perturbation- and tree-coverage-oriented training to expose policies to deviations they must recover from, rather than expected to emerge reliably from standard imitation learning.
summary_zh: 动作分块提升了通过行为克隆学习到的策略性能，已有多种机制被提出用以解释其原因，包括时间一致性、视界缩减、表示学习以及误差累积的减少。我们转而研究动作误差一旦进入系统后会发生什么。在每个状态下，我们注入一个小的动作误差，并测量在两种执行模式下该误差增长或收缩的速度：开环模式，即分块剩余部分在不重新规划的情况下回放；闭环模式，即策略在扰动后重新规划。拟合得到的速率将每个状态标记为收缩型、扩张型或无法解析型。在来自三个基准套件的十二个操作任务中，我们发现确信稳定的状态很少见，而在传播速率可解析的状态中，误差放大现象普遍存在。我们进一步发现，测得的传播速率强烈依赖于拟合视界：放大效应通常集中在前段，因此短窗口可能高估长视界下的传播情况。最后，我们基于这些标签训练预测器，发现仅凭相机帧和本体感觉即可恢复状态的开环模式，而闭环传播仅能部分恢复，因为它还取决于策略在扰动后的行为。这些结果表明，仅凭误差累积的论点无法完整解释动作分块：无论是被动的开环动态还是策略重新规划，都不能一致地收缩注入的误差，且重新规划很少能将开环放大转变为确信的收缩。这提示闭环反应性应当被显式训练，采用面向扰动和树覆盖的训练方式，使策略暴露于其必须恢复的偏差之中，而非期望其能可靠地从标准模仿学习中自发涌现。
tldr: This paper empirically analyzes the stability assumption behind action chunking by injecting controlled action errors and measuring their propagation under open-loop and closed-loop execution, finding that error amplification is common and replanning rarely yields confident contraction, thereby questioning error-compounding explanations and suggesting explicit training for closed-loop reactivity.
tldr_zh: 本文通过注入受控动作误差并测量其在开环和闭环执行下的传播，实证分析了动作分块背后的稳定性假设，发现误差放大普遍存在且重规划很少带来自信的收缩，从而质疑误差累积解释并提出应显式训练闭环反应能力。

title: Evaluating Physical Consistency and Plausibility in Generative Scenario Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Generative AI models are increasingly used for scenario generation in autonomous driving. While they can generate realistic-looking scenarios, they often provide limited transparency into learned representations and consistency with real-world vehicle dynamics. This lack of formal assurance limits their use in safety-critical validation and certification workflows. To address this aspect, we introduce a layered evaluation protocol that complements existing methods by assessing models across five layers. The first four layers inspect internal representations and network layers through kinematic alignment, statistical baseline comparison, latent controllability, and activation analysis. The fifth layer evaluates model outputs against vehicle dynamics constraints such as lateral jerk thresholds. We demonstrate the protocol on a Variational Autoencoder (VAE)-based scenario generator. Although standard output-level metrics and visualizations suggest that the generated scenarios are realistic, our protocol provides deeper insight into the extent to which the model's latent space aligns with kinematic features and whether visually plausible trajectories satisfy vehicle-dynamics constraints. We further apply the protocol to additional generative models, demonstrating its applicability beyond the VAE architecture.
summary_zh: 生成式人工智能模型越来越多地被用于自动驾驶中的场景生成。尽管它们能够生成外观逼真的场景，但在所学表征的透明度以及与真实车辆动力学的一致性方面，往往提供有限的可见性。这种形式化保障的缺失限制了其在安全关键性验证和认证流程中的应用。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种分层评估协议，通过五个层级对模型进行评估，以补充现有方法。前四个层级通过运动学对齐、统计基线比较、潜在可控性和激活分析来检查内部表征及网络层。第五个层级则依据车辆动力学约束（如横向加速度变化率阈值）对模型输出进行评估。我们在一个基于变分自编码器（VAE）的场景生成器上展示了该协议。尽管标准的输出级指标和可视化结果表明生成的场景具有真实性，但我们的协议能够更深入地揭示模型潜在空间与运动学特征的对齐程度，以及视觉上合理的轨迹是否满足车辆动力学约束。我们还将该协议应用于其他生成模型，证明了其适用性不仅限于VAE架构。
tldr: This paper introduces a layered evaluation protocol to assess the physical consistency and plausibility of generative scenario models for autonomous driving, demonstrating it on VAE-based and other generative models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种分层评估协议，用于评估自动驾驶生成场景模型的物理一致性和合理性，并在基于VAE及其他生成模型上进行了验证。

title: Towards Reliable Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language models (VLMs) are increasingly being explored in autonomous driving for tasks such as scene understanding, driving reasoning, decision-making, and end-to-end driving. As their role becomes more prominent, ensuring their robustness and reliability is increasingly important. In real-world conditions, visual inputs may be degraded by sensor imperfections and environmental conditions, potentially affecting both model predictions and their associated confidence. Such degradation is especially concerning in autonomous driving, where safety-critical decisions require models to make accurate predictions and recognize when their predictions may be unreliable. In this work, we evaluate five VLMs (Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma4-E4B, LLaVA-OneVision-7B, DriveFusion/DriveFusionQA-4B, and NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B) across four driving-related QA datasets with different visual input settings, including single-frame, multi-view, multi-frame, and monocular inputs. Our results show that the effects of visual corruption vary across models, datasets, and input settings, with changes in accuracy and confidence reliability and also differing across conditions. We then apply Visual Evidence Augmentation ($\mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle \mathrm{EA}}$), a recent inference-time method to examine whether it can improve model reliability under degraded visual conditions. We find that $\mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle \mathrm{EA}}$ improves performance for some models and datasets, although the gains are not consistent across all settings.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在自动驾驶领域日益被探索，应用于场景理解、驾驶推理、决策制定及端到端驾驶等任务。随着其作用日益凸显，确保其鲁棒性和可靠性变得愈加重要。在真实世界条件下，视觉输入可能因传感器缺陷和环境因素而退化，从而可能影响模型预测及其相关置信度。这种退化在自动驾驶中尤其令人担忧，因为安全关键的决策要求模型不仅能够做出准确预测，还需识别其预测可能不可靠的情况。在本研究中，我们评估了五种视觉-语言模型（Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma4-E4B、LLaVA-OneVision-7B、DriveFusion/DriveFusionQA-4B 和 NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B），在四个与驾驶相关的问答数据集上，采用不同的视觉输入设置，包括单帧、多视角、多帧和单目输入。结果表明，视觉损坏的影响因模型、数据集和输入设置的不同而有所差异，准确率和置信度可靠性均发生变化，且在不同条件下表现不一。随后，我们应用了视觉证据增强（$\mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle \mathrm{EA}}$），一种最新的推理时方法，以检验其能否在退化视觉条件下提升模型可靠性。我们发现，$\mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle \mathrm{EA}}$ 对部分模型和数据集提升了性能，但这些增益并非在所有设置下均保持一致性。
tldr: This paper evaluates the robustness and reliability of five Vision-Language Models for autonomous driving under various visual corruptions, and tests a Visual Evidence Augmentation (VEA) method to improve reliability, finding inconsistent gains.
tldr_zh: 该论文评估了五种视觉语言模型在自动驾驶中面对不同视觉损坏时的鲁棒性和可靠性，并测试了视觉证据增强（VEA）方法以提升可靠性，发现收益不一致。

title: Meta-Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Fast Adaptation of Interactive Policies with Applications to Autonomous Driving
summary: This paper develops a meta-multi-agent reinforcement learning (meta-MARL) framework to enable fast adaptation of interactive policies in a multi-agent system (MAS). Meta-reinforcement learning (meta-RL) enables agents to rapidly adapt to new tasks/environments using a bi-level optimization mechanism. However, existing meta-RL generally focuses on single-agent systems. Extending these frameworks and algorithms to multi-agent systems poses additional challenges, as tasks are characterized by not only the environment but also agents' strategic interactions. To address these challenges, we model multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) problems as Markov games (MGs) and develop a meta-MARL framework for rapid interactive policy adaptation across a distribution of MGs. A new concept, called meta-NE, is defined to describe the desired solution concept in a meta-MARL problem. Sufficient conditions for the equivalence between a meta-NE and a stationary point of the gradient-play-based meta-MARL algorithm are established. Our evaluation on autonomous-driving tasks demonstrates that the proposed meta-MARL method achieves faster adaptation than pretrained MARL baselines, validating the effectiveness of our framework.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种元多智能体强化学习（meta-MARL）框架，旨在实现多智能体系统（MAS）中交互策略的快速适应。元强化学习（meta-RL）通过双层优化机制，使智能体能够快速适应新任务或新环境。然而，现有元强化学习通常聚焦于单智能体系统。将这些框架和算法扩展到多智能体系统面临额外挑战，因为任务不仅由环境决定，还受智能体间的策略交互影响。为应对这些挑战，我们将多智能体强化学习（MARL）问题建模为马尔可夫博弈（MGs），并开发了一种元-MARL框架，以实现在博弈分布上的快速交互策略适应。本文定义了新概念——元纳什均衡（meta-NE），用以描述元-MARL问题中的理想解概念。同时，我们建立了元-NE与基于梯度博弈的元-MARL算法驻点之间等价的充分条件。在自动驾驶任务上的评估表明，所提出的元-MARL方法相比预训练的MARL基线实现了更快的适应速度，验证了该框架的有效性。
tldr: This paper proposes a meta-multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for rapid adaptation of interactive policies in multi-agent systems, specifically applied to autonomous driving. It introduces meta-NE as the solution concept and demonstrates faster adaptation than pretrained MARL baselines in driving simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个元多智能体强化学习框架，用于多智能体系统中交互策略的快速适应，并应用于自动驾驶。它定义了元纳什均衡作为解概念，并在驾驶仿真中展示了比预训练MARL基线更快的适应速度。

title: ROWBench: Do Video Models Render What the Program Specifies?
summary: Programmable world models separate executable dynamics from visual generation, offering a promising foundation for next-generation game engines. However, their visual adherence to explicit rules and interactions remains insufficiently evaluated. Existing benchmarks assess visual quality, controllability, and instruction or physical adherence, but rarely test fidelity to fine-grained, program-specified world events. We introduce PROWBench, comprising 170 programmatically constructed episodes and 600 proxy videos covering diverse scenes and interactions. PROWBench logs entity states and timestamped events, including those outside the camera's field of view, as replayable world records, from which it renders synchronized views and proxy representations. This enables generated videos to be checked against the observable consequences of program execution. An extensible framework constructs scenes, controls behaviors, and can render each camera view in different representations, such as coarse 3D, and bounding boxes. The benchmark covers first- and third-person perspectives, with synchronized multi-view observations available for a subset of episodes. Grounded in these records, PROWBench evaluates entity control, long-horizon memory, and, with two VLM-based metrics, Logic-Render Alignment and Interaction Success Rate, adherence to the prescribed timeline and the visual realization of timestamped engine-recorded events.
summary_zh: 可编程世界模型将可执行的动态与视觉生成分离，为下一代游戏引擎提供了有前景的基础。然而，它们对显式规则和交互的视觉遵循仍未得到充分评估。现有基准评估视觉质量、可控性、指令或物理遵循，但很少测试对细粒度、程序指定的世界事件的忠实度。我们引入了PROWBench，包含170个程序化构建的片段和600个代理视频，覆盖多样化的场景和交互。PROWBench将实体状态和带时间戳的事件（包括摄像机视野之外的事件）记录为可重放的世界记录，并从中渲染同步视图和代理表示。这使得生成的视频能够对照程序执行的可观察后果进行校验。一个可扩展的框架构建场景、控制行为，并能以不同表示渲染每个摄像机视图，如粗粒度3D和边界框。该基准涵盖第一人称和第三人称视角，并为部分片段提供同步多视角观察。基于这些记录，PROWBench评估实体控制、长时程记忆，并通过两种基于VLM的指标——逻辑-渲染对齐和交互成功率，来评估对规定时间线的遵循以及对带时间戳引擎记录事件的视觉实现。
tldr: PROWBench is a benchmark for evaluating visual fidelity of programmable world models to program-specified events, using logged entity states and timestamped events to verify generated videos.
tldr_zh: PROWBench是一个基准，用于评估可编程世界模型生成的视频是否符合程序指定的事件，通过记录实体状态和带时间戳的事件来验证。

title: World Observer: Joint Actor-Observer Generation for Persistent World Modeling
summary: How can a world model continuously observe regions beyond the actor's current view? Video world models simulate how an environment evolves from an agent's actions, yet remain actor-centric. Once an object leaves the actor's view, they lose direct evidence of its evolution, often failing to preserve its state and dynamics upon re-entry. To address this, we introduce World Observer, which decouples observing from acting by jointly generating a perspective actor for the agent-centric view with one or more panoramic observers that watch selected world regions. This allows objects that leave the actor's view to remain visually evolving in an observer, so their updated states are reflected when they re-enter. We ground the actor and observers by warping from a shared panoramic source for explicit geometric correspondence, and introduce an Observer Sink of high-resolution perspective references to restore fine appearance upon re-entry. Since the observers are decoupled from the actor, they can be placed freely across the scene, extended to multiple locations for broader coverage, and driven by control signals to steer out-of-view evolution. To evaluate out-of-view evolution, we further introduce world-space metrics and a benchmark spanning real and synthetic scenes. World Observer substantially improves out-of-view dynamics while remaining competitive in visual fidelity, camera control, and 3D adherence.
summary_zh: 摘要：世界模型如何持续观察智能体当前视野之外的区域？视频世界模型通过智能体的动作模拟环境演变，然而其仍以智能体为中心。一旦物体离开智能体的视野，模型便失去对其演变的直接证据，往往无法在该物体重新进入视野时保持其状态与动态。为解决此问题，我们提出“世界观察者”（World Observer），它通过联合生成一个面向智能体视角的透视智能体，以及一个或多个监视选定世界区域的全景观察者，将观察与行动解耦。这使得离开智能体视野的物体能够在观察者中持续进行视觉演变，从而在它们重新进入视野时反映其更新后的状态。我们通过从共享全景源进行扭曲映射来锚定智能体与观察者，以实现显式几何对应，并引入一个由高分辨率透视参考组成的“观察者汇”（Observer Sink），以在重新进入时恢复精细外观。由于观察者与智能体解耦，它们可自由放置于场景各处，扩展至多个位置以实现更广覆盖，并通过控制信号驱动视野外演变的引导。为评估视野外演变，我们进一步引入世界空间度量标准以及涵盖真实与合成场景的基准测试。世界观察者在显著提升视野外动态表现的同时，在视觉保真度、相机控制与三维一致性方面保持竞争力。
tldr: World Observer introduces a world model that jointly generates an actor-centric view and panoramic observers, enabling persistent modeling of out-of-view regions and improved dynamics upon re-entry.
tldr_zh: World Observer 提出了一种世界模型，联合生成以智能体为中心的视图和全景观察者，从而实现对视野外区域的持续建模，并在物体重新进入视野时改善其动态状态。

title: Weather-Aware Domain Adaptation for Street-View Weather Recognition
summary: Adverse conditions such as rain, snow, fog, and dust remain challenging for camera-based perception in autonomous driving. We study multi-class weather recognition from street-view images under domain shift, where most available training data come from non-street-view sources that differ markedly from real driving scenes. We propose Weather-Aware Adversarial Discriminative Domain Adaptation (WA-ADDA), which conditions the domain discriminator on predicted weather to promote features that are both domain-invariant and weather-sensitive. We also assemble a multi-dataset benchmark by unifying diverse non-street-view weather collections as sources and real street-view images as targets, and define a standardized evaluation protocol with macro accuracy as the primary metric. Across backbones (ResNet-50, EfficientNet, VGG, DenseNet), WA-ADDA consistently improves street-view performance and yields strong per-class recalls in challenging conditions while preserving clear-weather accuracy. These findings highlight the feasibility of domain-adapted weather recognition and the value of our benchmark for advancing robust, on-board perception.
summary_zh: 恶劣天气条件（如雨、雪、雾和扬尘）对基于摄像头的自动驾驶感知仍然构成挑战。本文研究了域偏移下街景图像的多类别天气识别问题，其中大部分可用的训练数据来自非街景来源，与真实驾驶场景存在显著差异。我们提出了一种天气感知对抗性判别域适应方法（WA-ADDA），该方法将域判别器基于预测天气进行条件约束，以促进既具有域不变性又对天气敏感的特征学习。我们还构建了一个多数据集基准，将多样化的非街景天气数据集统一作为源域，真实街景图像作为目标域，并定义了以宏平均准确率作为主要指标的标准化评估协议。在多种骨干网络（ResNet-50、EfficientNet、VGG、DenseNet）上，WA-ADDA均持续提升了街景性能，并在具有挑战性的条件下取得了较高的各类别召回率，同时保持晴朗天气下的准确率。这些发现凸显了域适应天气识别的可行性，以及我们的基准在推动稳健机载感知方面的价值。
tldr: This paper introduces Weather-Aware Adversarial Discriminative Domain Adaptation (WA-ADDA) to improve multi-class weather recognition in street-view images for autonomous driving, addressing domain shift from non-street-view training data. It also presents a unified multi-dataset benchmark and evaluation protocol, showing consistent improvements across various backbones.
tldr_zh: 本文提出天气感知的对抗判别域适应（WA-ADDA），用于改善自动驾驶中街景图像的天气识别，解决训练数据非街景导致的域偏移问题，并构建了统一的多数据集基准，在多个骨干网络上获得一致提升。

title: iSEE: Object Permanence Through Self-Supervision
summary: Object permanence, keeping track of an object's identity and position while it is occluded, is central to video representations that track, predict and plan. Trackers that achieve it learn from boxes, track identities and visibility labels. On the other hand, self-supervised object-centric methods discover objects without labels: through slot attention, it represents a video as slots that bind to objects and follow them across frames. However, these slots are lost under occlusion, making the desired permanence impossible. Reasoning permanence is a hard problem because it requires to detect when an object becomes occluded, re-identify when object reappears, and keep the object's hidden position continuous, using reapperance as the only learning cue. To address this, we propose iSEE, a novel framework that offers all three aforementioned requirements, without any labels whatsoever. We built iSEE using the following three proposed components: (i) Object evidence modelling: a slot's attention, compared with its own past, reveals when its object is hidden. (ii) Appearance-position separation: two slot streams let the appearance be held for re-identification while the position keeps changing. (iii) Permanence from reappearance: a walker follows the hidden object's position, trained only on where the object reappears. On LA-CATER static, iSEE returns a reappearing object to its own slot after 86% of occlusions, against 32% for SlotContrast, and localises it while hidden within 4.1 mAP of the label-trained SoTA RAM. The two streams also allow downstream planning, with the position stream as the action of a world model. Project page: https://insait-institute.github.io/iSEE/
summary_zh: 物体恒存性——即在物体被遮挡时追踪其身份与位置的能力——是视频表征中追踪、预测与规划的核心。实现这一能力的追踪器依赖于边界框、身份标识及可见性标签进行学习。另一方面，自监督的以物体为中心的方法无需标签即可发现物体：通过槽注意力机制，视频被表征为绑定到物体并跨帧跟随它们的槽。然而，这些槽在遮挡情况下会丢失，使得理想的恒存性无法实现。推理恒存性是一个难题，因为它要求检测物体何时被遮挡、在物体重新出现时进行再识别，并保持物体隐藏位置的连续性，且仅以重新出现作为唯一的学习线索。为解决这一问题，我们提出iSEE，一个无需任何标签即可满足上述三项要求的新型框架。我们通过以下三个组成部分构建了iSEE：（i）物体证据建模：槽的注意力与其自身过往状态相比较，可揭示其对应物体何时被隐藏。（ii）外观-位置分离：两个槽流使外观得以保持以用于再识别，同时位置持续更新。（iii）由重新出现推导恒存性：一个行走器跟踪隐藏物体的位置，仅以物体重新出现的位置作为训练信号。在LA-CATER静态数据集上，iSEE在86%的遮挡后将重新出现的物体归还至其原有槽，而SlotContrast仅为32%；在隐藏状态下定位的平均精度（mAP）达到4.1，接近有标签训练的SOTA RAM。双流结构还支持下游规划任务，其中位置流可作为世界模型的动作。项目页面：https://insait-institute.github.io/iSEE/
tldr: iSEE proposes a fully self-supervised framework that enables object-centric slot representations to maintain object permanence under occlusion by separating appearance and position streams, using reappearance as the only learning cue, and enabling downstream world-model planning.
tldr_zh: iSEE 提出了一种完全自监督的框架，通过分离外观和位置流，仅利用重现身作为学习线索，使基于槽位的物体中心表示在遮挡下保持物体永久性，并支持下游世界模型规划。

title: Towards Subject Consistency over Dynamic Subject Sets in Video Generation
summary: We argue that as video generation extends to longer durations, subject consistency should be evaluated over \textit{dynamic subject sets}. We therefore introduce \textbf{DynSC-Eval}, an evaluation framework that dynamically tracks eligible subjects throughout their visible lifespans and measures local continuity and global identity preservation using six complementary object-level metrics, with explicit detection of inconsistency events. To validate its effectiveness, we design synthetic experiments that actively inject inconsistency events, demonstrating both the sensitivity of DynSC-Eval and the limitations of existing metrics. Evaluations of diverse models on 5s, 15s, and 60s video generation further reveal substantial subject consistency differences that are obscured by conventional metrics. Beyond evaluation, we construct rewards from DynSC-Eval and apply DiffusionNFT post-training in an autonomous-driving testbed. On 5s generation, our approach reduces the six inconsistency metrics by an average of 13.82\% for Wan-2.1-1.3B and 5.66\% for SANA-2B, with improvements also observed on the I2V model ReSim. Qualitative comparisons further demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. We then extend generation to 10s and 30s through curriculum learning and show that consistency optimization remains effective while largely preserving other capabilities.
summary_zh: 我们认为，随着视频生成时长延长至更久，主体一致性的评估应在动态主体集合上进行。为此，我们引入了 **DynSC-Eval** 评估框架，该框架可在其可见生命周期内动态追踪合格主体，并使用六项互补的对象级指标来衡量局部连续性和全局身份保持，同时显式检测不一致事件的发生。为验证其有效性，我们设计了主动注入不一致事件的合成实验，既展示了DynSC-Eval的敏感性，也揭示了现有指标的局限性。对多种模型在5秒、15秒和60秒视频生成上的评估进一步表明，存在以往传统指标所掩盖的显著主体一致性差异。在评估之外，我们从DynSC-Eval构建奖励，并将其应用于自动驾驶测试平台中的DiffusionNFT后训练。在5秒生成任务中，我们的方法使Wan-2.1-1.3B和SANA-2B六项不一致性指标平均分别降低了13.82%和5.66%，在I2V模型ReSim上也观察到了改进。定性比较进一步验证了我们方法的有效性。随后，我们通过课程学习将生成时长扩展至10秒和30秒，并表明一致性优化依然有效，同时在很大程度上保留了其他能力。
tldr: This paper introduces DynSC-Eval, an evaluation framework for subject consistency in long video generation with dynamic subject sets, and applies its rewards to post-train diffusion video models in an autonomous-driving testbed, reducing inconsistency metrics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了DynSC-Eval，一个针对动态主体集的视频生成中主体一致性的评估框架，并将其奖励用于自动驾驶测试平台中的扩散模型后训练，降低了不一致性指标。

title: SemanTok: Predictable Semantic Tokens for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Recent video-based world models pair the scalability of autoregressive (AR) prediction with the visual quality of diffusion models. The choice of scene tokenizer is paramount for the optimal performance of each of these, both in terms of fidelity and semantics. Flexible-length, coarse-to-fine tokenizers yield exactly that: the first coarse tokens carry the clip's global semantics while later tokens further specify details. Existing flexible tokenizers only apply a representation-alignment (REPA) loss on early decoder hidden states, a target the decoder can partly meet from its noised input instead. We introduce SemanTok, a flexible video tokenizer that feeds frozen DINO features into its encoder and adds lightweight heads that reconstruct them from each retained token prefix alone. SemanTok achieves high semantic alignment and video fidelity at every AR model size: a 201M SemanTok AR model matches or beats a VideoFlexTok AR model $3.4\times$ its size, and larger SemanTok AR models further improve fidelity. It keeps semantic alignment on out-of-distribution classes and gives the decoder higher semantic alignment at every noise level, including pure noise. It performs well in both reconstruction and generation, and its short token prefixes are cheaper to predict and give better generation fidelity, with pixel detail deferred to later tokens.
summary_zh: 近期基于视频的世界模型将自回归（AR）预测的可扩展性与扩散模型的视觉质量相结合。场景分词器的选择对于这两者在保真度和语义方面的最优性能至关重要。灵活长度、从粗到细的分词器恰好实现了这一点：前面的粗粒度分词携带视频片段的全局语义，而后面的分词则进一步细化细节。现有的灵活分词器仅对早期解码器隐藏状态施加表示对齐（REPA）损失，而解码器可以部分地从其加噪输入中满足这一目标。我们提出了SemanTok，一种灵活的視頻分词器，将冻结的DINO特征馈入其编码器，并添加轻量级头，仅从每个保留的分词前缀重建这些特征。SemanTok在所有AR模型规模下均实现了高语义对齐和视频保真度：一个201M的SemanTok AR模型可媲美或超越其3.4倍规模的VideoFlexTok AR模型，更大的SemanTok AR模型则进一步提升保真度。它在分布外类别上保持了语义对齐，并在每个噪声级别（包括纯噪声）下为解码器提供更高的语义对齐。它在重建和生成两方面均表现良好，其短分词前缀预测成本更低，且生成保真度更高，像素细节则延后至后续分词。
tldr: SemanTok introduces a video tokenizer that incorporates frozen DINO features and lightweight reconstruction heads to produce semantically aligned, flexible-length tokens, enabling more efficient and higher-quality autoregressive video generation and world models.
tldr_zh: SemanTok 提出了一种视频分词器，利用冻结的 DINO 特征和轻量重建头生成语义对齐、长度灵活的 token，从而提升自回归视频生成和世界模型的效率与质量。

title: Variational Streaming Flow: Probabilistic Forecasting in Physical Time
summary: Probabilistic forecasting is important for predicting complex dynamical systems because intrinsic randomness and incomplete observations can cause the same observed state to evolve into multiple plausible futures. While flow matching is a flexible approach for probabilistic forecasting, it is computationally expensive. Streaming flow (SF) reformulates this approach to model temporal evolution efficiently by learning a continuous velocity field directly in physical time. However, SF learns a deterministic velocity field. Thus, it provides only a single future trajectory for a given fixed initial state and observation history. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Variational Streaming Flow (VSF). Our approach learns a latent distribution that is conditioned on the dynamics of interest. In turn, this enables probabilistic forecasting. Importantly, we retain the computational efficiency of SF by generating in physical time. Across deterministic and stochastic dynamical systems, VSF demonstrates superior predictive accuracy and distributional fidelity. We demonstrate the advantage for both long-horizon rollouts exceeding 1,000 steps, and settings with bifurcating dynamics. Moreover, VSF can be integrated into existing Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA)-based world models as a plug-and-play predictor to improve temporal dynamics and goal-directed success rate in navigation, motion planning, and manipulation.
summary_zh: 概率预报对于预测复杂动力系统至关重要，因为固有随机性和不完整的观测可能导致相同的观测状态演化为多种可能的未来。尽管流匹配是一种灵活的概率预报方法，但其计算成本较高。流式流（SF）通过直接在物理时间中学习连续速度场，对该方法进行重构，从而高效地建模时间演化过程。然而，SF学习的是确定性速度场，因此对于给定的固定初始状态和观测历史，仅能提供单一未来轨迹。为克服这一局限，我们引入了变分流式流（VSF）。该方法学习一个以目标动态为条件的潜在分布，从而实现概率预报。重要的是，我们通过在物理时间内生成轨迹，保留了SF的计算效率。在确定性和随机动力系统中，VSF均展现出优越的预测精度和分布保真度。我们证明了其在超过1，000步的长时程展开以及具有分叉动力学的场景中的优势。此外，VSF可作为即插即用的预测器集成到现有基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的世界模型中，以提升导航、运动规划和操作任务中的时间动态建模能力和目标导向成功率。
tldr: This paper introduces Variational Streaming Flow (VSF), a probabilistic forecasting method that extends streaming flow by learning a latent distribution over dynamics, enabling efficient and accurate probabilistic forecasts for dynamical systems, and demonstrates its utility as a plug-and-play predictor in JEPA-based world models for robot navigation, motion planning, and manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出变分流（VSF），通过学习动力学潜分布扩展流匹配，实现高效的概率预测，并可无缝集成到JEPA世界模型中，提升机器人导航、运动规划和操作的任务成功率。

title: SonarVoxNet: Diver Detection in 3D Bounding Box using 3D Sonar
summary: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) assisting human divers must continuously track not only the diver's 3D position but also their full-body orientation. However, vision-based perception is unreliable underwater, and forward-looking sonar -- despite being widely used -- discards the elevation information needed for orientation estimation, posing a fundamental limitation. Recently commercialized 3D sonar preserves elevation but produces sparse, noisy returns, and existing detectors are built for dense LiDAR data and for targets that remain upright and rotate only about the yaw axis (e.g., vehicles, pedestrians), making them unable to represent a freely pitching and rolling diver. To address this gap, we present two contributions. First, SonarVoxNet adapts a voxel-based encoder and an anchor-free center-based detection head to 3D sonar data, replacing the conventional yaw-only rotation representation with a continuous 6D rotation parameterization to predict full 9-DoF oriented bounding boxes -- to our knowledge, the first 3D sonar diver detector to do so. Second, Diver3D is the first public 3D sonar dataset with full 3D orientation labels for divers in diverse, non-upright poses, collected at a natural cave-diving site. Through controlled ablations over the backbone and detection head, we show that the dominant factor behind accurate 3D sonar-based diver detection is the transition from yaw-only rotation to full-SO(3) rotation. This transition substantially improves detection accuracy and reduces orientation error. These results demonstrate that full-body diver orientation is recoverable from 3D sonar alone, laying the groundwork for future work on diver pose estimation and diver-robot interaction.
summary_zh: 自主水下航行器（AUV）在协助人类潜水员时，不仅需要持续追踪潜水员的三维位置，还需追踪其全身姿态。然而，基于视觉的感知在水下环境中并不可靠，而前视声呐——尽管被广泛使用——却丢弃了姿态估计所需的仰角信息，这构成了根本性的限制。近年来商业化的三维声呐保留了仰角信息，但产生的数据稀疏且噪声较大，且现有检测器是为密集激光雷达数据以及保持直立、仅绕偏航轴旋转的目标（如车辆、行人）设计的，因此无法表示自由俯仰和横滚的潜水员。为弥补这一空白，我们提出两项贡献。第一，SonarVoxNet将基于体素的编码器与无锚框的基于中心的检测头适配至三维声呐数据，用连续的六维旋转参数化替代传统的仅偏航旋转表示，以预测完整的九自由度有向包围盒——据我们所知，这是首个实现该功能的三维声呐潜水员检测器。第二，Diver3D是首个公开的、包含潜水员多样化非直立姿态下完整三维姿态标签的三维声呐数据集，采集自天然洞穴潜水地点。通过对骨干网络和检测头的受控消融实验，我们表明，实现基于三维声呐的潜水员精确检测的主导因素是从仅偏航旋转向完整SO(3)旋转的转变。这一转变显著提升了检测精度并降低了姿态误差。这些结果表明，仅凭三维声呐即可恢复潜水员的全身姿态，为未来潜水员姿态估计及潜水员-机器人交互研究奠定了基础。
tldr: This paper introduces SonarVoxNet, the first 3D sonar-based diver detector predicting full 9-DoF oriented bounding boxes with continuous 6D rotation, along with the first public 3D sonar dataset (Diver3D) with full orientation labels. It demonstrates that full-SO(3) rotation representation is key to accurate diver detection, enabling diver-robot interaction for AUVs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SonarVoxNet，首个基于3D声呐的潜水员检测器，预测带有连续6D旋转表示的9自由度有向边界框，并发布了首个带完整姿态标注的Diver3D数据集。结果表明，完整的SO(3)旋转表示是准确检测潜水员的关键，为AUV与潜水员交互奠定基础。

title: OpenSpace Lab Solution to the IROS 2026 Indoor Exploration Competition
summary: This report presents the \textbf{OpenSpace Lab}'s solution to the Competition on Intelligent Information Gathering for Single and Multi-Robot Systems Workshops, organized as part of the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026. Our team reached 1st place in the Single-Robot Public Track and 3rd place in both the Single- and Multi-Robot Private Tracks. The single-robot framework utilizes pre-trained map completion predictions for global planning to prioritize unexplored areas. To reconcile map coverage with limited operation time, we introduce a remaining-time-based exploration strategy that integrates homing constraints into the decision-making process. For multi-robot exploration, we utilize a utility-driven target selection strategy that balances observation gains, movement costs, and budget constraints, leveraging shared map and intent data to eliminate redundant search and maximize coordination efficiency. Our solution reached a 61.04\% coverage rate in the Single-Robot Public Track, while reaching 39.53\% and 39.91\% coverage in the Single- and Multi-Robot Private Tracks, respectively. An extended full-length paper based on this report is currently being prepared for submission, and the source code will be released upon acceptance of the full manuscript at https://github.com/OpenSpace-Lab/Indoor-Exploration-IROS2026.
summary_zh: 本报告介绍了**OpenSpace Lab**针对IEEE/RSJ国际智能机器人与系统会议（IROS）2026期间举办的单机器人与多机器人系统智能信息采集竞赛所提出的解决方案。我们的团队在单机器人公开赛道上获得第一名，并在单机器人和多机器人私有赛道上均获得第三名。单机器人框架利用预训练的地图补全预测进行全局规划，优先探索未覆盖区域。为协调地图覆盖率与有限运行时间之间的矛盾，我们提出了一种基于剩余时间的探索策略，将返航约束纳入决策过程。对于多机器人探索，我们采用基于效用驱动的目标选择策略，该策略综合权衡观测收益、移动成本与预算约束，并利用共享地图与意图数据消除冗余搜索，最大化协同效率。我们的解决方案在单机器人公开赛道上达到61.04%的覆盖率，在单机器人和多机器人私有赛道上分别达到39.53%和39.91%的覆盖率。基于本报告的扩展全文正在准备投稿中，稿件一经录用，源代码将在https://github.com/OpenSpace-Lab/Indoor-Exploration-IROS2026 公开发布。
tldr: This paper presents an exploration strategy for single- and multi-robot systems that won awards at the IROS 2026 competition, using map completion predictions and utility-driven target selection to maximize coverage under time and budget constraints.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了在IROS 2026比赛中获奖的单机器人和多机器人探索策略，利用地图补全预测和效用驱动的目标选择来在时间和预算约束下最大化覆盖率。

title: Cross-entropy optimization with prioritized constraints
summary: When constraints conflict, an optimizer must determine which requirements to preserve and which to relax. On the one hand, a priority ordering specifies which requirements take precedence. On the other hand, penalty-based formulations encode their relative importance through numerical weights. Depending on these weights, a solution can improve its weighted score while violating intended priorities. We introduce TierCEM, a variant of the cross-entropy method that incorporates strict constraint priorities directly into elite selection without requiring per-constraint importance weights. TierCEM works by sequentially filtering sampled candidates, from highest- to lowest-priority constraint. If and when a constraint eliminates all remaining candidates, TierCEM returns to the last nonempty set and selects elites with the smallest violations of that blocking constraint, recursively preserving satisfaction of all higher-priority constraints. We evaluate TierCEM on 2D navigation and contact-rich pushing tasks in proprioceptive and learned world-model settings. Experiments show that reversing the constraint ordering changes which constraints are violated under conflict. Prioritizing progress toward the task objective also enables TierCEM to relax lower-priority constraints when they would otherwise prevent further progress.
summary_zh: 当约束条件相互冲突时，优化器必须决定保留哪些要求、放宽哪些要求。一方面，优先级排序规定了哪些要求优先满足。另一方面，基于惩罚的公式通过数值权重来表达各要求的相对重要性。根据这些权重的设置，解可能会在违背预定优先级的情况下改善其加权得分。我们提出了TierCEM，一种交叉熵方法的变体，将严格的约束优先级直接纳入精英选择过程，而无需逐约束的重要性权重。TierCEM通过从最高优先级约束到最低优先级约束逐级筛选采样候选解来实现。如果某个约束条件将所有剩余候选解全部淘汰，TierCEM将回溯到最后一个非空集合，并选择对该阻塞约束违反最小的精英解，从而递归地保证所有更高优先级约束的满足。我们在本体感知和 learned 世界模型设置下的二维导航及接触丰富的推物任务中评估了TierCEM。实验表明，颠倒约束顺序会改变冲突情况下被违反的约束。优先考虑任务目标的进展，也使TierCEM能够在低优先级约束阻碍进一步进展时放宽这些约束。
tldr: TierCEM enhances the cross-entropy method to enforce strict constraint priorities during elite selection, evaluated on 2D navigation and pushing tasks in proprioceptive and learned world-model settings.
tldr_zh: TierCEM 在精英选择中强制执行严格的约束优先级，并在 proprioceptive 和学习的世界模型设置中的 2D 导航和推动任务上进行了评估。

title: Extreme Length Generalization in a Compact Recurrent Architecture for One-Shot Exploration
summary: Autonomous robots on one-shot missions run over horizons far longer than the trajectories seen during training, under a fixed onboard compute budget. We present FRANK, a 507K-parameter recurrent architecture that combines tau-gated recurrent modules, content-addressable memory, and a feedforward reflex pathway. We evaluate it against recurrent, state-space, and reduced modular baselines at matched parameter count on four algorithmic sequence tasks, trained at length 5-20 and evaluated out to two million tokens. At 100,000x the maximum training length, 6 of 10 FRANK seeds retain exactly 100.0% accuracy, while none of the 50 baseline configurations does, five architectures at ten seeds each with none left incomplete (Fisher exact, two-sided p = 4.2E-6. Targeted lesions across the four tasks yield four distinct component-reliance profiles, consistent with task-dependent allocation across the recurrent, memory, and reflex pathways. Separately, a FRANK policy trained in simulation drives a physical ground vehicle to commanded waypoints through obstacles without teleoperation.
summary_zh: 自主机器人在单次任务中运行的时间跨度远超训练期间所见轨迹，且受限于固定的机载计算预算。我们提出了FRANK，一种包含507K参数的循环架构，结合了tau门控循环模块、内容可寻址存储器以及前馈反射通路。我们在四个算法序列任务上，以匹配的参数数量，将其与循环、状态空间及精简模块化基线进行对比评估，训练长度为5至20，评估延伸至两百万个令牌。在最大训练长度扩展至100,000倍的情况下，10个FRANK种子中有6个保持精确的100.0%准确率，而50个基线配置中无一达到此水平，五种架构各采用十个种子，均未出现不完整情况（Fisher精确检验，双尾p = 4.2E-6）。针对四个任务的定向消融实验揭示了四种不同的组件依赖特征，与循环、记忆及反射通路间的任务依赖分配相一致。此外，在仿真环境中训练的FRANK策略，无需远程操作即可驱动实体地面车辆绕过障碍到达指定路径点。
tldr: FRANK is a compact recurrent architecture achieving extreme length generalization on algorithmic tasks and demonstrates one-shot waypoint navigation on a physical ground vehicle, bridging sequence learning and embodied control.
tldr_zh: FRANK是一种紧凑的循环架构，在算法任务上实现了极端长度泛化，并在物理地面车辆上演示了单次航点导航，弥合了序列学习与具身控制之间的鸿沟。

title: The Effect of Gait Stability Based on Two Types of Impact Strategies for Two-Link Walking and Brachiating Robots
summary: In this paper, we explore the impulsive dynamics common to single-joint, two-link models of walking and brachiating gaits with respect to slope and switching time. In particular, we investigate how the stability of a gait and bifurcations encountered within a family of gaits change under time-based and state-based switching of the impulsive dynamics.
summary_zh: 本文探讨了行走与臂跃步态中单关节、两连杆模型在坡度与切换时间方面共有的冲击动力学特性。具体而言，我们研究了基于时间与基于状态的冲击动力学切换下，步态稳定性及步态族内分岔现象的变化规律。
tldr: This paper analyzes how time-based versus state-based switching of impulsive dynamics affects gait stability and bifurcations in two-link walking and brachiating robots.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了基于时间和状态的冲击动力学切换对双连杆行走和臂行机器人步态稳定性和分岔的影响。

title: On the Divergence of Accuracy and Mechanism Consistency in Time Series World Models
summary: A time series world model (TSWM) predicts a controlled system's state from its observed history and planned actions and exogenous inputs. Current approaches build forecasters with actions as covariates, trained and evaluated on prediction error under the executed plan. Yet world models compare unexecuted plans, but their responses to changed plans remain untested. We ask which design choices matter and whether accurate forecasters respond to changed plans as real systems do. We address both with a formalization and benchmark. The formalization separates state, actions and exogenous inputs, distinguishes continuous, mode and event actions, and introduces mechanism consistency, a metric built on declared action-state relations with known directions, such as a vasopressor raising blood pressure: it checks whether shifting an action moves the forecast in the declared direction. The benchmark consolidates eight public datasets with real actions from engineered infrastructure and clinical care, varying prediction space, plan fusion and plan encoding across seven backbones and five seeds. First, a frozen latent prediction space lowers MAE by 9.9% over observation space and gated output fusion lowers it by 12.7% over input concatenation on average, with both improving all eight datasets; temporal plan encoding changes average MAE by at most 2.2%. Second, prediction error and mechanism consistency diverge: the lowest-error configuration is at or below chance in consistency on four of five datasets with declared mechanisms, and no design choice avoids this. Finally, directional supervision, a loss penalizing the wrong-signed part of the response to a shifted action, significantly raises consistency on penalized mechanisms with no change in MAE. Together they give TSWMs a recipe: a frozen latent space and output-side fusion for accuracy, and a training objective for mechanism consistency.
summary_zh: 时间序列世界模型（TSWM）从观测到的历史数据、计划动作及外部输入中预测受控系统的状态。现有方法将动作作为协变量构建预测器，并在已执行计划下以预测误差进行训练和评估。然而，世界模型需要对未执行计划进行比较，但其对改变后的计划所作出的响应尚未得到验证。我们提出两个问题：哪些设计选择至关重要？准确的预测器是否能够像真实系统一样对改变的计划作出响应？我们通过形式化定义和基准测试来回答这两个问题。该形式化定义将状态、动作和外部输入分离，区分连续动作、模式动作和事件动作，并引入机制一致性（mechanism consistency）这一指标，其建立在已声明的动作-状态关系之上且方向已知，例如升压药可升高血压：该指标检验改变某个动作是否使预测向声明方向移动。该基准测试整合了来自工程基础设施和临床护理的八个公共数据集，包含真实动作，并在七个骨干网络和五个随机种子上变化预测空间、计划融合方式和计划编码方式。首先，冻结的潜在预测空间相较于观测空间平均降低MAE 9.9%，门控输出融合相较于输入拼接平均降低MAE 12.7%，且两者在所有八个数据集上均带来改进；时间计划编码对平均MAE的改变最多不超过2.2%。其次，预测误差与机制一致性出现分歧：在具有声明机制的五组数据集中，误差最低的配置在四组上的一致性达到或低于随机水平，且没有任何设计选择能够避免这一问题。最后，方向性监督——即对动作改变后响应中符号错误部分施加惩罚的损失函数——在被惩罚的机制上显著提升一致性，且MAE不变。综合而言，这些发现为TSWM提供了设计准则：采用冻结潜在空间和输出侧融合以提高精度，并采用训练目标以保证机制一致性。
tldr: This paper formalizes time series world models, introduces a mechanism consistency metric to test whether forecasters respond to action changes as real systems do, and finds that design choices improving accuracy can reduce mechanism consistency, proposing a directional supervision loss to improve it.
tldr_zh: 本文形式化了时间序列世界模型，引入机制一致性指标来检验预测器对动作变化的响应是否与真实系统一致，并发现提升准确性的设计选择可能损害机制一致性，提出方向监督损失以改善一致性。

title: Token Communication-Assisted Collaborative Embodied Artificial Intelligence: Concepts, Framework, and Opportunities
summary: Collaborative embodied artificial intelligence (CEAI) enables multiple physical agents to perceive, reason, and act cooperatively in dynamic environments. Effective communication is essential for CEAI, yet CEAI agents must exchange not only large multimodal observations but also task-relevant insights, intents, and interactive information over long horizons. This article investigates token communication (TokCom) as a native intelligence interface for CEAI, in which tokens serve jointly as compact semantic carriers for communication and fundamental inference units for generative foundation models (GFMs). We first discuss how TokCom supports insight sharing, intent alignment, and interactive control among embodied agents. We then propose a TokCom-assisted CEAI framework driven by a task-adaptive communication protocol. Comprising a compact codebook, syntax rules, and contextual examples, this protocol guides GFM-based transceivers to distill messages into compact tokens and reconstruct them after wireless transmission. A case study on collaborative object transport demonstrates that the proposed TokCom framework substantially reduces the source payload bit consumption while preserving task efficiency and showing robustness under noisy channels. Finally, we outline future research directions.
summary_zh: 协作式具身人工智能（CEAI）使多个物理智能体能够在动态环境中协同感知、推理与行动。有效通信对于CEAI至关重要，然而CEAI智能体不仅需要交换大规模多模态观测数据，还需在长时间跨度内传递与任务相关的洞察、意图及交互信息。本文探讨将令牌通信（TokCom）作为CEAI的原生智能接口，其中令牌同时作为紧凑的语义载体用于通信，并作为生成式基础模型（GFMs）的基本推理单元。我们首先讨论TokCom如何支持具身智能体之间的洞察共享、意图对齐和交互控制。随后，我们提出一种由任务自适应通信协议驱动的TokCom辅助CEAI框架。该协议由紧凑码本、语法规则和上下文示例组成，引导基于GFM的收发器将消息提炼为紧凑令牌，并在无线传输后将其重建。一项关于协作物体搬运的案例研究表明，所提出的TokCom框架在保持任务效率的同时，显著减少了信源有效载荷比特消耗，并在噪声信道下展现出鲁棒性。最后，我们展望了未来研究方向。
tldr: This paper introduces a token communication (TokCom) framework for collaborative embodied AI, where tokens serve as compact semantic carriers and inference units for generative foundation models, reducing communication overhead while preserving task efficiency in a simulated collaborative object transport case study.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于协作具身人工智能的令牌通信（TokCom）框架，令牌作为生成式基础模型的紧凑语义载体和推理单元，在协作物体搬运案例中降低了通信开销并保持了任务效率。

title: iADD: Improving Alignment and Diversity in Diffusion Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning based post training of diffusion models, such as Denoising Diffusion Policy Optimization (DDPO), optimizes a reverse diffusion process under a reward function. However, current approaches to reward optimizations do so at the cost of diversity and quality. In this paper, we provide better tradeoffs through careful theoretical considerations and method design. We analyze the theoretical framework and mathematically demonstrate that \emph{only-latter timestep} updates of diffusion model may be harmful for diversity contrary to the conclusions presented in a previous work. Additionally, we propose an incremental Feynman-Kac training based on strong theoretical foundations in order to achieve the best-yet alignment-diversity tradeoffs. We perform extensive experiments and compare our method against related diffusion policy optimization approaches in three different tasks and also provide strong ablations for each component, thus validating strong performance gains in both alignment and diversity.
summary_zh: 基于强化学习的扩散模型后训练方法，如去噪扩散策略优化（DDPO），在奖励函数下优化逆向扩散过程。然而，当前的奖励优化方法以牺牲多样性和质量为代价。本文通过细致的理论考量与方法设计，实现了更优的权衡。我们分析了理论框架，并从数学上证明，与先前工作中的结论相反，仅对扩散模型的后期时间步进行更新可能对多样性有害。此外，我们基于坚实的理论基础提出了一种增量式Feynman-Kac训练方法，以实现目前最佳的“对齐-多样性”权衡。我们进行了大量实验，在三个不同任务中将我们的方法与相关的扩散策略优化方法进行了比较，并对每个组成部分提供了充分的消融研究，从而验证了在对齐性和多样性方面的显著性能提升。
tldr: This paper improves diffusion policy optimization by theoretically analyzing timestep updates and proposing an incremental Feynman-Kac training method to achieve better alignment-diversity tradeoffs in reinforcement learning post-training of diffusion models.
tldr_zh: 本文通过理论分析时间步更新并提出增量 Feynman-Kac 训练方法在扩散策略优化中实现更好的对齐-多样性平衡。

title: Network World Models as Environments for Algorithm Design on Complex Systems
summary: World models, which simulate an environment and predict how it changes under actions, are increasingly used in real-world applications such as robotics. Complex systems call for the same tool because the effect of an action is not immediate. Seeding nodes for a campaign, or immunizing nodes against an epidemic, changes little on its own; what matters is the outcome that unfolds over the steps that follow. Designing an algorithm that selects such actions to maximize expected performance on a task is inherently iterative, and every candidate must be scored by the outcome it produces. Obtaining that outcome has relied on simulation, whose cost becomes a bottleneck when candidates are evaluated over many sampled trajectories. We propose an action-conditioned Network World Model that learns a network's diffusion dynamics under interventions over time, applies each action to the network, and predicts the outcome that follows. It serves as a fast evaluator inside an algorithm design loop in which a coding agent designs and refines executable algorithms using feedback from full rollouts, action-level credit, and counterfactual probes over alternative interventions. Across eight network tasks and five diffusion models, the designed algorithms match or exceed the strongest reported baseline in 138 of 141 settings while enabling up to 14.5 times faster rollouts than Monte Carlo simulation. Code will be released upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 世界模型通过模拟环境并预测其在行动作用下的变化，正越来越多地被应用于机器人技术等实际场景中。复杂系统同样需要这一工具，因为行动的效果往往并非即时显现。例如，为一场活动选择种子节点，或针对疫情进行免疫接种，短期内可能改变甚微；真正重要的是后续步骤中逐步展开的结果。设计一种算法以选择此类行动，从而最大化任务预期表现，本质上是一个迭代过程，每个候选方案都必须根据其产生的结果进行评分。而获取这些结果历来依赖模拟，当候选方案在大量采样轨迹上进行评估时，模拟成本便成为瓶颈。我们提出了一种基于行动条件的网络世界模型，该模型学习网络在干预措施作用下随时间的扩散动力学，将每种行动应用于网络，并预测随之而来的结果。该模型可作为算法设计循环中的快速评估器，在此循环中，编码代理利用完整轨迹展开、行动级信用分配以及针对替代干预的反事实探测反馈，来设计和改进可执行算法。在八个网络任务和五种扩散模型中，所设计算法在141种设置中的138种中达到或超过了最强已报道基线，同时实现了比蒙特卡洛模拟快高达14.5倍的轨迹展开速度。代码将在论文被接收后发布。
tldr: The paper introduces Network World Models, action-conditioned world models that learn network diffusion dynamics under interventions to serve as fast evaluators in an algorithm design loop, outperforming baselines on network tasks.
tldr_zh: 论文提出了网络世界模型，这是一种在干预下学习网络扩散动态的动作条件世界模型，作为算法设计循环中的快速评估器，在网络任务上优于基线。

title: Latent-Foresight: End-to-End Learning Predictable Representations for Latent World Models
summary: Predicting the future evolution of a scene is a fundamental capability for world modeling. Recent work has shown that operating in the feature space of Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) yields semantically rich representations that support diverse future scene understanding tasks. However, existing approaches rely on two-stage pipelines, where VFM features are first compressed using fixed dimensionality reduction (e.g., PCA) or independently trained autoencoders, and a separate predictor is trained on top of the resulting frozen latent space. This decoupling between representation learning and temporal prediction, as well as approaches that apply predictors directly on raw VFM features, provides no guarantee that the latent space is structured for predictable dynamics. In this work, we propose Latent-Foresight, an end-to-end framework that jointly learns a latent tokenizer and a flow-based generative dynamics model, explicitly shaping the representation to support temporal predictability. To enable stable joint optimization, we introduce several key design choices that prevent latent collapse and align reconstruction with generative objectives. Extensive experiments show that our approach learns more temporally coherent latent representations and consistently outperforms two-stage baselines across multiple future scene understanding tasks and prediction horizons, while eliminating separate training stages, including during high-resolution adaptation. We provide the implementation code and model weights at https://github.com/Sta8is/Latent-Foresight
summary_zh: 预测场景未来演变是世界建模的一项基本能力。近期研究表明，在视觉基础模型（VFM）的特征空间中操作，能够获得语义丰富的表征，从而支持多种未来场景理解任务。然而，现有方法依赖于两阶段流程，即首先使用固定降维技术（如主成分分析）或独立训练的自编码器对VFM特征进行压缩，然后在所得的冻结潜空间之上训练独立的预测器。这种表征学习与时间预测之间的解耦，以及直接在原始VFM特征上应用预测器的方法，都无法保证潜空间具备适于可预测动态的结构化特性。在本工作中，我们提出Latent-Foresight，一种端到端框架，联合学习潜分词器与基于流的生成式动力学模型，显式地将表征塑造成支持时间可预测性的形式。为实现稳定的联合优化，我们引入了若干关键设计选择，以防止潜空间坍缩，并使重建目标与生成目标保持一致。大量实验表明，我们的方法学习到的潜表征具有更强的时间连贯性，并在多项未来场景理解任务及预测时域上始终优于两阶段基线方法，同时消除了包括高分辨率适配在内的独立训练阶段。我们在https://github.com/Sta8is/Latent-Foresight 提供实现代码和模型权重。
tldr: Latent-Foresight proposes an end-to-end framework that jointly learns a latent tokenizer and a flow-based generative dynamics model to shape predictable representations for future scene understanding, outperforming two-stage baselines without separate training stages.
tldr_zh: Latent-Foresight 提出了一种端到端框架，联合学习潜在分词器和基于流的生成动力学模型，以塑造可预测的表示用于未来场景理解，在无需分离训练阶段的情况下优于两阶段基线。

title: FERPO: Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization
summary: Several state-of-the-art methods for online reinforcement learning in continuous control improve policies using action gradients of a learned critic. However, critics are typically trained to predict returns, and accurate value predictions do not necessarily yield accurate action derivatives, potentially leading to unreliable policy updates. We propose Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization (FERPO), an on-policy maximum entropy reinforcement learning algorithm that performs policy improvement using critic values without differentiating the critic with respect to actions. FERPO derives an optimal target action distribution from a policy-improvement objective regularized by entropy and Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence. We then fit the actor to this target by minimizing a forward-KL objective, estimated using self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS) with actions drawn from the rollout policy. By limiting the target distribution's deviation from the rollout policy, the KL regularization helps keep these importance weights well behaved. In contrast to reverse-KL objectives, which can favor a subset of the target distribution's modes, the forward-KL objective encourages coverage of multiple high-value modes and thereby promotes exploration. Experiments and ablations on MuJoCo Playground and ManiSkill show competitive performance and sample-efficiency gains. Computational benchmarks also demonstrate faster actor updates than Relative Entropy Pathwise Policy Optimization (REPPO).
tldr: FERPO proposes a new on-policy maximum entropy RL algorithm that updates the policy using critic values without differentiating the critic, improving sample efficiency and actor update speed on continuous control benchmarks like MuJoCo and ManiSkill.
tldr_zh: FERPO提出了一种新的在线最大熵强化学习算法，通过不使用批评者的动作导数来更新策略，在MuJoCo和ManiSkill等连续控制基准上提高了样本效率和actor更新速度。

title: BLT*: Informed Belief Localization Trees for Uncertainty-Aware Planning on Digital Twins
summary: We present Informed Belief Localization Trees* (Informed BLT*), a sampling-based belief space planning (BSP) algorithm that scales to large outdoor digital twins with point-cloud observations. We adapt RRT* and Informed RRT* to belief space using the $2$-Wasserstein ($W_2$) metric. Assuming isotropic Gaussian beliefs, sampled belief states can be connected efficiently while accounting for available information and probabilistic collision constraints. This enables steering and rewiring without repeatedly propagating observations, and allows previously computed measurement information to be reused. We present a framework to generate semantically labelled digital twins for planning in real-world environments with point-cloud-based localization. Experiments in simulated environments and digital twins show faster initial solution discovery in most maps with competitive cost convergence.
tldr: The paper introduces Informed BLT*, a sampling-based belief space planning algorithm for outdoor digital twins with point-cloud observations, using the 2-Wasserstein metric to efficiently connect belief states under isotropic Gaussian assumptions and probabilistic collision constraints, enabling faster initial solution discovery with competitive cost convergence.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Informed BLT*，一种基于采样的信念空间规划算法，适用于具有点云观测的户外数字孪生环境，利用2-Wasserstein度量在假设各向同性高斯的条件下高效连接信念状态，并在概率碰撞约束下实现更快的初始解发现和具有竞争力的成本收敛。

title: Training-Free Diffusion Planning with Analytical Local Scores
summary: Path finding and multi-robot motion planning require trajectories that are smooth, goal-directed, and collision-free in environments with complex geometric constraints. Recent diffusion-based planners have shown that trajectory generation can be cast as iterative denoising which has opened the doors to learning-based approaches that can handle multi-modal trajectory distributions and refine entire trajectories. However, a key limitation is that diffusion planners require training on large collections of feasible trajectories, rendering them map-specific, and difficult to deploy when high-quality demonstrations are unavailable. This paper introduces a training-free diffusion-based motion planner that replaces learned global trajectory scores with analytical local scores derived from obstacle, smoothness, velocity, and inter-agent feasibility terms. The proposed idea relies on a key observation: the score of a trajectory can be reconstructed by considering only local interactions between neighboring waypoints and nearby constraints. This structure exploitation yields a decomposed denoising procedure that retains the optimization structure of classical trajectory methods while inheriting the iterative refinement behavior of diffusion models. Experiments on a large collection of complex environments and large multi-agent planning tasks show that the proposed analytical score produces smooth and feasible trajectories within limited computational costs, for example in generating feasible paths for 300+ agents in environments containing 100+ obstacles in under 6 seconds on a GPU, outperforming strong learning-based and optimization baselines, while avoiding the data requirements of learned diffusion planners.
tldr: This paper introduces a training-free diffusion-based motion planner that uses analytical local scores for trajectory generation, enabling fast and feasible multi-robot planning in complex environments without requiring large datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种无需训练的扩散运动规划器，利用解析局部分数生成轨迹，在复杂环境中实现快速且可行的多机器人规划，无需大量数据集。

title: TouchTherm: Building Multimodal Digital Twins of Objects for Tactile and Thermal Rendering
summary: Robotic simulation and virtual reality increasingly require object assets that capture not only visual geometry but also the physical cues underlying tactile and thermal interaction. Existing 3D datasets and reconstruction methods primarily represent object-scale geometry and visual appearance, overlooking microscale surface structure for high-fidelity haptic rendering and transient temperature dynamics for temperature-aware interaction. We present TouchTherm, a framework for constructing simulation-ready visuo-tactile-thermal object assets from real-world objects. For visual and tactile reconstruction, we combine structured-light scanning with multiview normal maps obtained from photometric stereo. The normal maps are registered to the scanned geometry and transformed into tangent space to recover local micro-height fields for optical tactile rendering, while the coarse mesh handles collision detection. For thermal reconstruction, we capture synchronized multiview infrared videos of natural cooling following controlled heating and reconstruct a physics-regularized dynamic thermal field. Experiments on 20 objects show that the reconstructed micro-height fields preserve dominant surface structures and recover higher-frequency details beyond the coarse geometry, while the thermal fields achieve held-out surface-temperature MAEs of 0.465 degrees C and 0.592 degrees C at 30 s and 45 s, respectively. The resulting tactile assets support synthetic-to-real object recognition from tactile observations, while a glove-based VR system demonstrates spatially and temporally varying thermal feedback. These results highlight the potential of TouchTherm for multimodal sensory simulation and temperature-aware virtual interaction.
tldr: TouchTherm constructs multimodal visuo-tactile-thermal assets from real objects by combining structured-light scanning, photometric-stereo normal maps for micro-height fields, and physics-regularized thermal fields from infrared videos, enabling high-fidelity haptic and thermal rendering in simulation and VR.
tldr_zh: TouchTherm通过结合结构光扫描、光度立体法获取的微高度场和红外视频重建的物理正则化热场，从真实物体构建视觉-触觉-热多模态资产，实现高保真触觉和热渲染。

title: LiteReality-Agent: An Agentic System for Interactable 3D Indoor Scene Reconstruction
summary: We present LiteReality-Agent, an agentic system for reconstructing real indoor environments as realistic, articulated, and simulation-ready 3D scenes from RGB-D scans. At its core, LiteReality-Agent formulates 3D reconstruction as a coding problem, in which a coding agent gathers evidence using specialised tools and iteratively edits a Python script, Room.py, which can be executed to produce a 3D digital twin of the room. With this formulation, we develop a robust observe-edit-verify harness that supports evidence gathering, measurement, verification, layout optimisation, simulation readiness, and quality control throughout the reconstruction process. LiteReality-Agent produces high-quality reconstructions suitable for simulation and downstream embodied AI tasks. Furthermore, as agent capabilities continue to improve rapidly, the system introduced by LiteReality-Agent remains a strong orchestration framework for future agents: it equips them with specialised tools, structured workflows, and robust verification mechanisms that substantially improve reconstruction quality and reliability. We demonstrate that LiteReality-Agent produces reconstructions that are more geometrically accurate, visually realistic, and simulation-compatible than those generated by recent frontier models, such as Astra and Fable. We therefore view LiteReality-Agent as a practical and important building block for robust real-to-sim systems. Both the source code and the data-capture application are publicly available. Code:https://github.com/LiteReality/LiteReality-Agent/
tldr: LiteReality-Agent is an agentic system that reconstructs real indoor scenes as simulation-ready, articulated 3D digital twins from RGB-D scans by framing reconstruction as a coding problem, using an observe-edit-verify harness with specialized tools.
tldr_zh: LiteReality-Agent 是一个智能体系统，通过将重建视为编码问题，利用观察-编辑-验证框架和专用工具，从 RGB-D 扫描中重建出可模拟的、带关节的室内三维数字孪生。

title: Beyond Leaderboard Scores: A Deployment-Focused Protocol for Interpretable Tracking Evaluation in Pedestrian-Centric Environments
summary: Mobile robots operating among pedestrians need trajectories that become available quickly, remain spatially credible through missed observations, preserve identity, and fit within an embedded computing budget. Aggregate tracking scores provide limited insight into when and how trajectories fail, while varying detector inputs can confound tracker and detector quality. We present a deployment-focused, tracker-only evaluation protocol that uses shared detections to isolate tracker behavior and directly evaluates initialization, detector-gap continuation, identity recovery, close-neighbor association, and load-dependent tracker-step runtime, while Higher Order Tracking Accuracy (HOTA) is retained as a complementary aggregate measure. We apply the protocol to the JackRabbot Dataset and Benchmark (JRDB) using six open-source trackers and our lightweight Pedestrian Reference Tracker (PedRefTrack), together with a GT-assisted variant that estimates the remaining tracker-side gap under idealized association and motion. Under fixed detections, the non-GT trackers span only 24.26%-29.67% HOTA yet exhibit markedly different capability profiles. After 1.0 s without detector support, no tracker without GT assistance maintains spatially correct, same-identity output in more than half of eligible cases, making missing-observation continuation the dominant limitation among the tested properties. Close-neighbor failures are smaller and increase mainly at the shortest separations. Tracker-step runtime on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin is heavy-tailed and load-sensitive, causing several trackers to fall below the 10 Hz real-time target in crowded frames. The protocol provides a reproducible way to characterize tracker behavior and deployment suitability in pedestrian-centric environments. Code and evaluation scripts are released at https://github.com/SCAI-Lab/tracker_eval.
tldr: This paper introduces a deployment-focused evaluation protocol for pedestrian tracking in mobile robotics, isolating tracker behavior with shared detections and assessing capabilities like initialization, continuation, identity recovery, and runtime on embedded hardware; experiments on JRDB show poor missing-observation continuation and heavy-tailed runtime as key limitations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向部署的行人跟踪评估协议，通过共享检测分离跟踪器行为，并评估初始化、缺失观测延续、身份恢复及嵌入式运行时等能力；在JRDB上的实验表明，缺失观测延续能力差和运行时重尾分布是关键局限。

title: Managing Context and Communication in Distributed Agentic UAV Swarms
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarms increasingly rely on language-model agents to provide adaptive mission-level reasoning in uncertain environments. Fully distributed control, in which each UAV hosts an independent Small Language Model (SLM), removes reliance on a centralized coordinator but introduces an information-management problem: long-running interaction histories can degrade the reasoning context, while indiscriminate information dissemination increases communication and inference overhead. We address these challenges with a distributed UAV-agent architecture that enables continuous local SLM control through an event-driven reason-act-observe lifecycle. Runtime knowledge is represented as structured atomic notes and organized into core, local, and peer-specific memory. A deterministic interest-aware gossip engine selectively disseminates these notes according to recipient-specific semantic novelty and recency. We evaluate the architecture using ten UAVs in a simulated search-and-rescue mission. Our approach completes all experimental runs, whereas unrestricted flooding messages completes only 70-85\%, and delegating forwarding decisions to the SLM prevents mission completion in every run. Compared with unrestricted flooding, our approach approximately halves inference-token consumption, reduces transmitted data, and achieves lower survivor-count error.
tldr: This paper presents a distributed UAV swarm architecture where each UAV hosts a Small Language Model (SLM) for mission-level reasoning, using a structured memory and gossip-based communication protocol to manage context and reduce overhead, validated in a simulated search-and-rescue task with ten UAVs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种分布式无人机蜂群架构，每架无人机搭载小型语言模型（SLM）进行任务级推理，通过结构化记忆和基于八卦的通信协议来管理上下文并降低开销，并在包含十架无人机的模拟搜救任务中进行了验证。

title: Real-Time Human-Adaptive Task Allocation for Multi-Human Multi-Robot Supervision
summary: We propose a human-factor-aware method of allocating robot supervision tasks to multiple human operators. In scenarios where multiple operators occasionally teleoperate multiple robots to help the robots overcome difficulties, the allocation of the supervisory control tasks to humans needs to consider the real-time cognitive states of individual operators. However, most existing methods assume fixed supervisory capacity per operator and overlook fluctuations in the human factors such as workload and fatigue. As a result, workload distribution can be unbalanced where some operators become overloaded while the others remain underused. Our method dynamically regulates supervisory capacity and allocates tasks in a way that maintains balanced mental workload, prevents overload, and improves overall team performance. The allocation method uses a greedy strategy that minimizes estimated operator workloads with task prioritization. Robots are assigned to operators by reflecting their current supervisory capacity where the required effort depends on the types of tasks. In the user study, the analysis across predefined time intervals shows that the proposed method consistently achieves higher performance and lower behavioral signs of fatigue compared to a baseline method that does not consider human factors. These results highlight adaptive capacity adjustment as an effective preventive mechanism for sustaining operator performance in long-duration, high-demand settings.
tldr: This paper proposes a human-factor-aware task allocation method for multi-human multi-robot supervision, which dynamically adjusts supervisory capacity based on operator workload and fatigue to balance workload and improve team performance. User studies show the method reduces fatigue and increases performance compared to a baseline that ignores human factors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种面向多人类多机器人监督的人因感知任务分配方法，根据操作员工作负载和疲劳动态调整监督能力，以平衡工作负载并提升团队绩效。用户研究表明该方法相比不考虑人因的基线方法能降低疲劳并提高性能。

title: 4Director: Controlling Video World Models with Rigid 3D Geometry
summary: Precise control over camera and object motion is essential for professional video production. Existing methods control objects only coarsely, through image-plane cues that are ambiguous in depth and rotation or through 3D tracks and blobs that lack complete geometry and lose consistency across viewpoint changes. We introduce 4Director, a video world model conditioned on an explicit 4D scene representation: each object is reconstructed once from the input image as a canonical mesh and moved by one prescribed rigid transformation per frame. This representation provides an intuitive 3D control interface and prevents unobserved geometry from being regenerated independently in every frame. We render the controlled scene as a depth video and introduce a Motion Adapter that transforms this geometric scaffold into video while synthesizing view-consistent appearance, illumination, and non-rigid dynamics. For training, we construct RealCOD-Rigid, a new dataset of 20,774 clips annotated with rigid 3D scenes by our automatic pipeline. We further introduce Identity-Gated IoU (IG-IoU), which jointly evaluates adherence to prescribed object motion and preservation of object identity. Experiments demonstrate that 4Director consistently outperforms prior methods in visual quality and in camera and object control.
tldr: 4Director is a video world model conditioned on explicit rigid 3D scene representations to enable precise control over camera and object motion, outperforming prior methods in visual quality and control accuracy.
tldr_zh: 4Director是一种基于显式刚性3D场景表示的视频世界模型，能够精确控制相机和物体的运动，在视觉质量和控制准确性上优于现有方法。

title: CLoSeR: Closing the Loop for Long-Context Streaming Reconstruction
summary: Feedforward foundation models have recently shown remarkable 3D reconstruction capabilities. However, existing models exhibit large tracking drift in long-context streaming reconstruction due to error accumulation. In this paper, we revisit loop closure with streaming reconstruction foundation models to enable accurate, drift-free, kilometer-scale reconstruction. Specifically, our method detects loop candidates through global descriptor retrieval, and constructs loop-conditioned windows to estimate the relative poses between looped frames. Given the observation that our adopted streaming reconstruction backbone produces a globally consistent scale, we optimize all frame poses on the SE(3) manifold with sequential and loop closure constraints, avoiding the pose graph optimization on the Sim(3) or higher-dimensional SL(4) manifolds employed in prior works. Extensive experiments show that our method reduces drift and produces consistent geometry on kilometer-scale sequences, significantly outperforming the state of the art. Code is available at https://github.com/MoyangLi00/CLoSeR.git.
tldr: CLoSeR introduces loop closure to streaming 3D reconstruction foundation models, using global descriptor retrieval and pose graph optimization on SE(3) to achieve drift-free, kilometer-scale reconstruction.
tldr_zh: CLoSeR 将闭环引入流式三维重建基础模型，通过全局描述符检索和 SE(3) 上的位姿图优化，实现无漂移的千米级重建。

title: Towards Physical Underwater Robotic Assistance for Scuba Diver Movement in Confined Spaces
summary: Scuba divers are taught to control their depth to avoid rapid ascents and descents, which could result in serious injuries such as gas embolisms and barotrauma. However, many underwater tasks necessitate lateral control, maintaining distance between subsea structures such as coral reefs, submerged drilling instrumentation, or unexploded ordnance. In this work, we discuss a first-of-its-kind wearable robotic solution providing thruster-actuated directional guidance to a diver, as distinct from prior propulsive-assistance exoskeletons. We introduce ``Robotic Assisted Diver Movement in Confined Spaces'' (RADMCS), a wearable robot that assists divers in maintaining a fixed distance from subsea structures by leveraging perception techniques in monocular depth estimation and force-feedback from submersible thrusters to provide haptic feedback. Its small and compact form factor creates a foundational platform that could be expanded to include more sophisticated control and navigation behaviors. We present results from Institutional Review Board (IRB) in-water studies with eight human scuba diver participants on threshold sensitivity tests in both a closed-water swimming facility and ocean environments; distance-maintaining experiments in a closed-water facility; and form, fit, and function testing in the ocean. We demonstrate that relatively low thrust values (10 percent of maximum) allow robotic direction of a human's movement using the physical sensation of the robot's guidance.
tldr: This paper presents RADMCS, a wearable thruster-based robot that provides haptic directional guidance to scuba divers for maintaining distance from subsea structures in confined spaces, validated with in-water human studies.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了RADMCS，一种基于推进器的可穿戴机器人，通过触觉反馈引导潜水员在受限空间内与海底结构保持距离，并通过真人水下实验验证。

title: OrbitTAMP: Grounding Language Models for Task and Motion Planning in Spacecraft Rendezvous
summary: Spacecraft rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO) are currently planned through an expertise-intensive process in which engineers translate high-level operational intent into safe, dynamically feasible trajectories, creating a bottleneck to scalable operations. Large language model (LLM)-based agents could offer an intuitive interface for this process, although their outputs are not inherently grounded in orbital dynamics, operational constraints, or the structure of admissible spacecraft maneuvers. To exploit their semantic reasoning while ensuring the generated plan's physical validity, this paper presents a hierarchical framework for spacecraft task-and-motion planning (TAMP) that grounds LLM reasoning in a graph of reusable behaviors and domain-specific planning modules. Within this framework, a pretrained LLM maps a natural-language command to a partial mission specification. The associated planners then resolve unspecified decisions within the admissible operational space. Finally, trajectory optimization converts the completed mission specification into a dynamically feasible trajectory. Numerical experiments demonstrate that this architecture substantially improves intent recovery over direct LLM generation, achieving 98% exact recovery of partial mission specifications across all evaluated splits when backed by frontier LLMs. Additional test-time-compute experiments show that, for a compact 9B model, verifier-guided revision increases exact recovery from 75% to 88%, while broader behavior-plan search independently improves selection among admissible trajectory realizations. Overall, these results establish a scalable and auditable foundation for language-driven agentic planning of spacecraft RPO.
tldr: This paper presents OrbitTAMP, a hierarchical framework that grounds LLM reasoning in reusable behavior graphs and domain-specific planners to generate safe, dynamically feasible spacecraft rendezvous trajectories from natural-language commands.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了OrbitTAMP，一种层次化框架，将LLM推理嵌入可重用行为图和领域特定规划器中，从而从自然语言指令生成安全、动态可行的航天器交会轨迹。

title: Online Planning for Sparse Ground Target Search from a High-Altitude UAV under Partial Observability
summary:
Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) searching for ground targets from a high altitude face a unique challenge, particularly when the target is already within the field of view but effectively unobservable because of its small apparent scale. Standard object detectors often underperform in such scenarios because of resolution downscaling and limited context. In contrast, active object search frameworks address this challenge by directing the agent to a suitable pose to gather richer visual information. However, flight regulations in urban airspace often restrict such physical movements for UAVs. As an alternative active sensing approach, the UAV can leverage the pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) mechanism of the onboard camera to dynamically adjust its field of view and sequentially gather enhanced visual information from specific regions of interest.
